khai_niem.la_nguoc: A reversed card is one drawn upside down. In Waite's way, a reversed card means the card's quality is blocked, weakened, turned inward or passing — not a bad sign. Marseille and Thoth readers do not use reversals; they read the neighbouring cards instead. Here you choose whether to use them when you shuffle.
khai_niem.an_chinh: The 22 Major Arcana (0 The Fool → XXI The World) speak of the big chapters and forces beyond your control; the 56 Minor Arcana (four suits: Wands – Cups – Swords – Pentacles) speak of everyday matters.
khai_niem.pham_gia: Elemental dignities (Golden Dawn): each card carries an element; two neighbouring cards of the same element strengthen each other, Fire is friendly with Air and Earth, Water with Air and Earth, while Fire–Water and Air–Earth oppose. It is the 'neighbouring card' way of reading instead of reversals.
khai_niem.decan: A decan is one third of a zodiac sign (10 degrees, about 10 days). The Golden Dawn tied the 36 pip cards 2–10 to the 36 decans — here used as a timing hint, not a forecast date.
khai_niem.dai_dien: The significator is the court card chosen to 'play' the person asking. Waite chose by age and appearance; here it comes from the face shape you observed yourself plus your age — for you alone.
khai_niem.celtic: The Celtic Cross is the ten-card spread Waite recorded in 1910: a cross of six cards (heart of the matter, what crosses it, root, recent past, what you aim for, near future) and a staff of four (you, your surroundings, hopes and fears, likely outcome).
khai_niem.tarot_la_gi: Tarot is a deck of 78 cards from 15th-century Italy, used from the 18th–19th century to reflect on a question. Here tarot is a way of looking at something again through images and four sourced schools — not a prediction, not a substitute for a doctor, a lawyer or your own decision.
khai_niem.da_so: When a spread leans heavily toward one group of cards, the Golden Dawn (Book T) reads one extra layer for the whole table: many Wands point to energy and friction; many Cups to feeling and enjoyment; many Swords to worry, tension and things that need saying plainly; many Pentacles to work, money and possessions; many Major Arcana to forces larger than your own arranging; many court cards to a matter that involves many people; many Aces to strength and fresh starts. Read this background first, then go card by card. It is not a prediction.

quay_lai: Write down why it ended last time — has that changed?
Have one straight conversation instead of guessing.
Ask yourself whether you miss the person or the old feeling.
chia_tay: Have one straight conversation before deciding.
Ask one friend you trust, not many people.
If there is violence or a safety issue, get help right away.
ket_hon: Talk openly about money, where to live and children.
Spend enough time with both families.
Do not decide while being rushed.
hen_ho: Meet new people through things you enjoy doing.
Go slowly and watch how the other person behaves when things are not fun.
Keep your own rhythm of life.
gia_dinh: Pick a moment when everyone is calm to talk.
Say what you need instead of blaming the past.
Ask someone the whole family trusts to mediate if it gets tense.
chuyen_nha: Visit the new place at several different times of day.
Count the full cost of moving and the first month.
Ask the neighbours about the area.
di_xa: Have a job or a place to stay sorted before you go.
Keep enough for the trip back if it does not work out.
Ask people who went before you and use legal channels.
suc_khoe: Sleep enough at regular hours for 7 days straight.
Have a check-up if it has been a while.
Drop one thing from this week's schedule. Cards are not medical advice.

cong_viec: Write down what you want to have a year from now.
Ask someone ahead of you in the trade.
Take the first step this week.
tien_bac: Write down this month's money in and out.
Keep an emergency fund before any big spend.
Do not decide about money in a hurry.
tinh_cam: Have one straight conversation instead of guessing.
Look at what the other person does, more than what they say.
suc_khoe: Drop one thing from this week's schedule.
_chung: Write down what you truly want.
Take one small step within 72 hours.

dai_0.hinh_anh: A young man holding a white rose, a bundle slung over his shoulder on a stick, walks toward the edge of a cliff with his eyes on the sky; a small dog leaps at his heels.
dai_0.y_xuoi: You are standing before a step that has no map yet. This card says: go, travel light, and leave room for what you do not know. The cliff edge in the picture is not there to make you fall; it is there so you know where you are.
dai_0.y_nguoc: Reversed: the step is being put off, or taken blindly without looking at your feet. Ask yourself: am I afraid to start, or am I jumping so I don't have to think?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A new relationship, or a fresh way of seeing someone you already know; light and unbound. Not the time to make big promises.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: The start of a job, a project or a new role; your strength is freshness, your weak spot is inexperience. Ask someone who has done it one question before you step.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money is in a 'trial' phase: small amounts, no plan yet. Don't put a large sum into something you don't understand.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your pace is light and suits walking and a change of scenery. Mind your feet and the moments when you rush.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Standing forever at the doorway, or rushing in before you know each other. Set up one more ordinary meeting so you can see more clearly.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The new thing is being delayed out of fear, or jumped into without looking. Write down three things you don't know about it yet, then go and ask.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Easy to spend on impulse, or to sit on money and dare nothing. Set a small limit for the trial amount and stop when you reach it.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: An uneven rhythm, careless when in a hurry. Go to bed on time for a few nights and slow down one notch when you are out on the road.

dai_0.viec: Do ONE small piece of the thing you keep postponing because you are 'not ready yet' - today, in 30 minutes.
dai_0.cau_tu_soi: The last time you started something without knowing how it would turn out, what did it teach you?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: start, as long as the first step is small and you accept not knowing everything. Check one thing: if it goes wrong, can I step back?
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you can separate fear from recklessness. Before you decide, ask someone who has done this and set yourself a maximum for the trial.

dai_1.hinh_anh: A man stands behind a table laid with four objects - a wand, a cup, a sword and a coin; one hand raises a wand to the sky, the other points to the ground, and the infinity sign floats above his head.
dai_1.y_xuoi: You already have all the tools on the table; what is left is to get to work. This card is about focus: turning an idea into a task, and words into action.
dai_1.y_nguoc: Reversed: skill is being used to show off or to cut corners, or you have everything you need and still do nothing. Ask yourself: am I doing the work, or performing it?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: You are appealing and have a way with words. The relationship needs you to do what you promised, not just to speak well.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A good time to present, negotiate or start a project. You have the skills; the problem is choosing one thing.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money comes from craft and from how you speak. Be careful with offers that sound too smooth, whether yours or someone else's.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm suits skilled hands and a busy mind. Rest your eyes and hands after every hour.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Words are running ahead of actions, possibly on both sides. Keep one small promise fully this week before making another.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Skills are spread thin or kept for display. Pick one task and take it to something you can hand in before accepting more.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Be wary of quick-money invitations that sound too smooth. Transfer nothing until there is paperwork and you have asked a second person.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: A racing mind and a body that moves little. Set a reminder to stand up every hour and cut screens before bed.

dai_1.viec: Write down four things you already have for this (energy, money, people you know, time) - then use one of them today.
dai_1.cau_tu_soi: Which thing have you 'known how to do' for a long time and still not done?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: you already have what you need. The condition is to pick one thing and start now, without waiting for more tools.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: check whether this offer is transparent, and whether you truly want to do it or only want to be seen doing it.

dai_2.hinh_anh: A woman sits between a black pillar and a white one, in front of a veil embroidered with pomegranates, a scroll in her hands; a crescent moon rests at her feet.
dai_2.y_xuoi: There is something you already know but have not said, even to yourself. This card says: it is not yet time to act. This is a time to listen and wait for the veil to lift.
dai_2.y_nguoc: Reversed: you are brushing aside what you sense, or something around you is being kept hidden. Ask yourself: what is it I don't want to know?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A relationship with much left unsaid; its pull comes from reserve, but too much reserve and the other person cannot get in.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Not enough information to decide; there is something behind the scenes worth asking about. Suits research, writing and keeping professional confidences.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Hold your money; don't open anything new yet. There is a clause or a figure you haven't read carefully.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm needs quiet and enough sleep. Your body is saying something small; listen instead of brushing it off.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Something is unsaid, or you are ignoring your own feelings. Pick a quiet moment, ask one direct question and listen to the whole answer.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You are deciding on the surface while some facts stay hidden. Ask for the full documents and read them once more before you answer.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: A clause or fee is tucked away. Read the small print and ask again in writing before you sign.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: You are ignoring small signals such as lingering tiredness or broken sleep. Note them for a few days and keep your regular check-up.

dai_2.viec: Postpone the decision for 48 hours; meanwhile write down what you 'feel' about this and haven't dared to say.
dai_2.cau_tu_soi: What have you known about this for a long time while waiting for someone else to say it?

tra_loi.x: Possibly, once you know enough: this card says something has not yet come to light. Ask more, wait a few days, and notice your own first feeling.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: something is being hidden, or you don't want to know it. Find what you are avoiding before you say yes.

dai_3.hinh_anh: A woman sits at ease on a cushioned seat amid ripe wheat, a stream and a forest; her gown is embroidered with pomegranates and she wears a crown of twelve stars.
dai_3.y_xuoi: Things are growing naturally, like a plant with enough sun and water; you need to tend them, not force them. This card is about abundance and the power to nurture, both what you give to others and what you give to yourself.
dai_3.y_nguoc: Reversed: you are caring for others until you run dry, or something isn't growing because it isn't being tended. Ask yourself: who is nourishing me?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Warm feelings; a time to think long-term or about adding to the family. Be careful not to smother until the other person has no room to breathe.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: The project is bearing fruit; suits creative work, caring for clients, making things beautiful. Don't take on more just because you can't say no.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money comes in steadily from what you planted earlier. Suits long-horizon plans; avoid spending to fill a feeling of lack.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Treat your body like a garden: eat enough, sleep enough, get some sun. If you are pregnant or planning to be, follow your doctor's schedule.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You are giving more than you have, or the relationship is going untended. Say one thing you need and accept one small thing in return.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The project has stalled for lack of care, or you are carrying other people's work. Hand back one task that isn't yours this week.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Easy to spend on others until your own fund runs short, or to buy things to soothe yourself. Set aside a portion for yourself first.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Looking after everyone and forgetting yourself: rushed meals, short sleep. Sit down for one calm meal a day and go to bed earlier.

dai_3.viec: Cook a proper meal for yourself, water the plants, or tidy a corner of your desk - one real act of care, 20 minutes.
dai_3.cau_tu_soi: What are you nurturing - and is it nurturing you back?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this has ground to grow in. The condition is that you tend it steadily and wait patiently instead of demanding results right away.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: that you still have the energy. Check whether you are taking this on because you want to or because you can't bear to refuse. If you are running on empty, better to postpone.

dai_4.hinh_anh: A king sits on a stone throne carved with ram heads, holding a sceptre and an orb, armour showing beneath his red robe; bare rocky mountains rise behind him.
dai_4.y_xuoi: The matter needs a frame: clear rules, who does what, by when. This card is about the strength to step up and take responsibility, and it also reminds you that a frame is there to hold, not to squeeze.
dai_4.y_nguoc: Reversed: the frame is turning into control, or you are dodging a role you need to carry. Ask yourself: what am I afraid of if I let go a little?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A dependable, steady but dry presence. The relationship needs you to soften where being right doesn't matter.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A managing role; suits building processes and team discipline. Careful: the more orders, the less people do.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money should have a plan and spending discipline. A good time to set a budget, not a time to gamble.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm needs fixed hours. If you tend to tense your shoulders and jaw, remember to loosen them; don't take on everything and forget to rest.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: One side is making every decision, or avoiding its share of the load. Let the other person decide one shared matter this week.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The process is so rigid it chokes, or there is no one at the wheel. Settle who decides what and write it where the whole team can see.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: The budget is either squeezed too hard or left unattended. Sit down, make a simple spending sheet and keep a reserve.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Stress from wanting to control everything; neck and shoulders tire easily. Delegate one task and take a full half-day off this week.

dai_4.viec: Write a three-line 'rule' for this matter (who - what - by when) and stick it where you see it every morning.
dai_4.cau_tu_soi: Where are you 'playing king' when really you are just afraid of losing control?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes, if there is a plan: this card backs doing things properly. Check three things: the budget, who is responsible, and the timeline.
tra_loi.n: Better to change the approach first: the plan lacks a frame or is squeezed too tight. Look again at who has the right to decide and why, then move.

dai_5.hinh_anh: A robed priest sits between two pillars, one hand raised in blessing, the other holding a triple-barred staff; two figures kneel before him and two keys lie crossed at his feet.
dai_5.y_xuoi: This matter has customs, people who went before, and a method that has been tested. The card says: ask someone experienced and follow the convention before you innovate, and learn which customs are worth keeping.
dai_5.y_nguoc: Reversed: the rules are binding you, or you are breaking them just to break them. Ask yourself: am I going against it because I understand it, or because I haven't bothered to learn it?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A relationship moving toward going public, meeting the family, engagement or marriage. Say clearly what each of you considers 'the right way' at home.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Suits organisations with structure, apprenticeship, qualifications and mentors. Follow the process before proposing changes.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money through traditional channels: banks, insurance, clear contracts. Avoid channels you only 'heard about'.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: A rhythm built on routine; keep your regular check-ups on schedule. Eating by family habit is good if the habit is healthy.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Family custom or outsiders' expectations are weighing on the two of you. Talk privately about what you really want before asking anyone's opinion.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The old rules no longer fit, or you want to do things differently without understanding them. Learn the old way thoroughly, then propose the change in writing.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Easy to follow money advice just because the speaker has a title. Read the papers carefully and ask one independent source.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Your eating and sleeping routine has slipped, or you keep a habit only because it is familiar. Change one small unhealthy habit and keep your check-up schedule.

dai_5.viec: Call or message one person with experience in this, and ask exactly one specific question.
dai_5.cau_tu_soi: Which custom in your family is kept only because 'it has always been this way'?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes, by the familiar route: this card suits methods many people have already tested. Ask someone experienced and complete the proper steps.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, once you understand why you want to break with custom. If it is only to oppose someone, stop and think more; if you do understand, prepare your reasons clearly.

dai_6.hinh_anh: A naked man and woman stand beneath an angel with outstretched wings; behind the woman is a tree with a serpent, behind the man a tree of flames, and a mountain rises between them.
dai_6.y_xuoi: A choice made with the heart: not right versus wrong, but 'what do I truly want'. This card is about commitment and about telling the truth, to the other person and to yourself.
dai_6.y_nguoc: Reversed: a choice is being made out of fear of losing, or the two of you are out of step and no one has said so. Ask yourself: am I keeping this person out of love, or because I dread change?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Feelings are becoming clear; it may be time to say what has gone unsaid. If you are torn between two people, this card says choose by your values, not by fear.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Partnership, or a choice between two directions. Suits matters that need both sides to talk it through; don't let anyone choose for you.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Shared money decisions (family, partners) need both sides to agree on paper.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: A light rhythm; suits walking or exercising with a partner. Mind your breathing and your hands when sitting for long.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The two of you are out of step and no one has said it, or you are staying because change feels awkward. Name one thing that doesn't fit, in an ordinary tone of voice.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The partnership has drifted in its goals, or you chose a direction under pressure. Write down what each side wants and set the lists side by side.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Shared money gets tangled because each person counts differently. Compare the records and agree again on paper how to split things.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Your routine is being pulled along by someone else; late nights, eating on a whim. Keep your own bedtime.

dai_6.viec: Tell the person involved ONE true thing you have been holding back for more than two weeks.
dai_6.cau_tu_soi: If no one were watching, what would you choose?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes, if this matches your values. Check: you are choosing because you want it, not because you fear losing the other option.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: the choice is being steered by fear or temptation. Wait until you can say clearly why you are choosing, and the people involved agree.

dai_7.hinh_anh: A warrior stands in a stone chariot beneath a starry canopy; a black sphinx and a white one lie before it with no reins, and a city stands in the background.
dai_7.y_xuoi: You are moving forward and winning, by keeping two opposing forces going in one direction. This card is about the will to hold the reins: not forcing, but not letting go.
dai_7.y_nguoc: Reversed: the two sphinxes are pulling in opposite directions; the matter is losing control, or you are pushing so hard that the person beside you loses. Ask yourself: where am I racing to?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: You are taking the lead in the relationship; good if you share a direction, tiring if the other person only gets to sit in the back.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: The project is in motion; suits travel, relocation and closing deals. Keep a moderate speed; too fast and things fall off.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money from decisiveness; suits buying a vehicle or travelling far. Don't chase two money goals at once.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your pace is speeding up. Mind your back, neck and sleep when travelling a lot; if you drive, ease off one notch.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You are pulling in two directions, or you try to win every argument. Stop one debate and ask where you both want to go.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The matter has lost direction from too many goals or from forcing beyond your strength. Cross off one goal and keep the one that matters most.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Easy to spend heavily to keep up with others. Postpone the big purchase by at least a week and don't borrow more.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Running over the speed limit, sleeping little, back and neck tense. Drive slower and drop one task a day to make room for rest.

dai_7.viec: Pick one unfinished task and push it past a clear milestone within three days - then stop, and don't open anything new.
dai_7.cau_tu_soi: Where are you winning and still not feeling at peace?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card suits determination and action. The condition is that you pick one clear direction and keep a pace you can sustain.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: you are being pulled in two directions. Settle what you truly want and drop one goal before you speed up.

dai_8.hinh_anh: A woman crowned with flowers gently closes the jaws of a lion; the infinity sign hovers above her head, with a green meadow and mountains behind.
dai_8.y_xuoi: Strength here is not muscle but a gentle hand that can close a lion's mouth: patience with what is wild in you and in others. This card says: you don't need to strain.
dai_8.y_nguoc: Reversed: you are either straining or giving up; instinct (temper, fear, craving) is holding your hand. Ask yourself: who am I really fighting?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Feelings need patience and gentleness; don't use pressure. If someone is heated, wait until they cool down before you talk.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Work that needs staying power, taming something difficult (a hard client, a hard task). You win through persistence, not commands.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money needs soft discipline: ease the urge to buy rather than banning it. Stamina beats one big blow.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your body has good endurance; steady exercise suits you better than heavy sessions. Keep your heart check-ups on schedule and steady your breathing when anger rises.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Anger or jealousy is speaking for you, or you have held back until you are drained. Wait until you are calm, then say briefly what you need.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Straining at a hard task until exhausted, or losing confidence in front of a difficult person. Break the work into parts and ask for help with one.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Easy to buy on emotion when tired or sad. Make a rule to wait 24 hours before any purchase that isn't needed right away.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Stress piling up; eating and sleeping go off rhythm. Practise slow breathing for a few minutes each evening, and see your doctor for a check-up if tiredness lingers.

dai_8.viec: When a flash of temper or a craving rises in the next three days, count 10 breaths before you act.
dai_8.cau_tu_soi: Which 'lion' in you are you treating gently, and which one are you pinning down?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: you have the strength for this, if you go by patience rather than force. Check: can I keep calm when I hit an obstacle?
tra_loi.n: Possibly, once you regain your self-control. Don't decide while angry, afraid or exhausted; sleep on it and look again.

dai_9.hinh_anh: An old man in a grey cloak stands on a snowy peak, one hand raising a lantern that holds a six-pointed star, the other leaning on a staff; he looks down.
dai_9.y_xuoi: Now is a time to step back from the noise and look again: alone, with a lamp. This card is about looking into things carefully, asking someone who has been there, and the quiet you need before deciding.
dai_9.y_nguoc: Reversed: solitude has become isolation, or you are hiding from the task under the name of 'needing to think'. Ask yourself: am I reflecting, or hiding?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A pause is needed. If single, no rush; if in a couple, each of you needs some time alone, said plainly to the other.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Suits research, deep study, working alone. Not the time to launch or expand; find a mentor.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Review your spending, read contracts carefully, save. Not the time to follow the crowd with your money.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your body needs early nights and less noise. Mind your digestion when eating alone in a hurry; take a slow walk in the evening.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The pause has become distance and the other person finds it hard to reach you. Send a message to check in, or arrange a short meeting.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Working alone for too long, reluctant to ask anyone. Bring what you are working on to someone you trust and hear their feedback.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Avoiding your spending records, or deciding every amount without asking anyone. Go through this month's figures with someone who knows the subject.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Rarely going out, rarely seeing people; sleep rhythm drifts. Spend some time outdoors each day and talk with one person.

dai_9.viec: One evening without screens: write down three things this situation has taught you so far.
dai_9.cau_tu_soi: When was the last time you sat still for 30 minutes doing nothing?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: this card says you need more time to think, or to ask someone who knows the matter. Step forward once things are clear inside you.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you stop stalling under the name of 'still thinking'. Set a concrete deadline to decide and ask at least one person's opinion.

dai_10.hinh_anh: A great wheel hangs in the sky bearing the letters TARO and Hebrew characters; a sphinx with a sword sits on top, a serpent and a jackal-headed figure flank it, and four winged creatures read books in the corners.
dai_10.y_xuoi: Something is turning that is not of your doing: luck, circumstances, other people. This card says: don't cling to what is passing; keep your hands ready for what is arriving.
dai_10.y_nguoc: Reversed: the wheel is turning slowly, or you are resisting a change you would do better to follow. Ask yourself: what am I holding on to that has finished its turn?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Feelings may change rhythm: a surprise meeting, a return, or a new chapter. No one is to blame; it is the rhythm.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Opportunity comes from outside, a bit of luck at work. Seize it quickly, knowing it also passes.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money rises and falls with markets and chance. Keep a cushion so you don't have to sell at a low point.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your body follows the seasons. When you notice a shift in sleep or appetite, note it and keep an eye on it; don't treat yourself.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: An old story is repeating, or you cling to a rhythm that has passed. Look at what is different this time and try responding another way.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Opportunity is slow to arrive, or you are resisting a change that is already clear. Do your current work well and get your papers ready for when the door opens.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Money is on a down or flat stretch. Don't sell in a hurry or borrow to recover; keep your reserve and wait.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Eating and sleeping are sliding back into old unhealthy patterns. Log your bedtime for a week to see where to adjust.

dai_10.viec: List three things in this situation that are NOT in your hands and cross them off your worry list; keep the ones that are.
dai_10.cau_tu_soi: Have you seen this situation 'turn' before - and how did it end that time?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: circumstances are moving your way. Take it now, but prepare a way back, because a favourable stretch has its end.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: the timing isn't right, or you are repeating an old choice. Wait for things to become clearer and look at what you learned last time.

dai_11.hinh_anh: A figure sits between two pillars, the right hand holding a sword upright, the left a pair of scales; the robe is red and the crown is square.
dai_11.y_xuoi: Everything is being weighed: you receive exactly what you sowed, no more and no less. This card is about clear-headed decisions, documents, plain speech, and carrying your own share.
dai_11.y_nguoc: Reversed: there is unfairness somewhere, or you are dodging your part of the responsibility. Ask yourself: if the scales were honest, what would I owe, and to whom?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: The relationship needs to be even-handed: who gives, who receives. Formal matters (registration, dividing property) should be set out in writing.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Contracts, legal matters, evaluations, appraisals. Decide by reason, with records; if you are wrong, admit it early.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Taxes, contracts, splitting shared money - put it on paper. For legal disputes, ask a lawyer, not a card.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm needs balance: work and rest, eating and movement. Mind your lower back when sitting long, and keep your regular check-up.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Something is uneven: one person always gives, the other always receives. Speak plainly about each side's share of the work and the money.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: An unfair evaluation, or you are pushing blame elsewhere. Keep your evidence and own your part of the mistake first.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: The documents, the contract or the split has a mismatch somewhere. Go through it line by line; for anything big, ask a lawyer.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Work and rest are out of balance, with long hours sitting. Get up and move every hour and keep your check-up schedule.

dai_11.viec: Write two columns for this matter: my part - their part. Fix one imbalance within 72 hours.
dai_11.cau_tu_soi: Where are you demanding fairness, and where are you quietly enjoying unfairness?

tra_loi.x: Yes, on a condition: that everything is clear. This card backs a fair decision with paperwork. Check the contract and ask yourself whether you can live with the consequences.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: something is still unfair or not transparent. Clarify responsibilities and reread the terms; for legal matters, ask a lawyer.

dai_12.hinh_anh: A man hangs by one foot from a T-shaped tree, the other leg bent to form a four, hands behind his back, his face calm and ringed with light.
dai_12.y_xuoi: The matter is standing still, and this card says that is not a fault. Hanging upside down lets you see the world the other way round: what you thought was a loss may be letting go at the right time. Not the moment to struggle.
dai_12.y_nguoc: Reversed: stuck and refusing to see it differently, or 'sacrificing' to be loved. Ask yourself: am I waiting, or hiding from a decision?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Feelings are in suspense: one waits, the other hasn't decided. Don't push, but set yourself a deadline.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: The project is on hold, awaiting approval or someone's answer. A good time to look at the work from another angle, not to pile on pressure.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money is tied up (late payments, stuck capital). Not the time to open new commitments; accept writing off a small amount to move on.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your body needs real rest: lie down, stretch, hang loose. Keep an eye on circulation in your legs and blood pressure at your check-ups.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The waiting has gone on too long, or you keep giving way to be loved. Set yourself a deadline and say what you need.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The task is stuck because you keep waiting for others. Do the part that is in your hands and ask clearly when to expect an answer.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Money is stuck and you won't cut your losses. Accept letting a small amount go to free the rest; don't borrow to hold on.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Long sitting, little change of posture, a sluggish mood. Stretch for a few minutes each morning and keep your regular check-up.

dai_12.viec: Pick one thing you keep pushing that won't budge - pause it for 7 days and note what you see when you stop trying.
dai_12.cau_tu_soi: What are you 'sacrificing' that no one actually asked for?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: this card says pause and look at the matter from another angle. The answer tends to appear once you allow yourself to wait a little longer.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: that you stop waiting for someone else to decide for you. Set a deadline and choose. Check whether waiting longer still helps at all.

dai_13.hinh_anh: An armoured skeleton rides a white horse carrying a banner with a white rose; a king lies fallen beneath, a priest clasps his hands, a child offers flowers, and the sun rises between two distant towers.
dai_13.y_xuoi: Something is ending to make room: a phase, a role, a way of living. This card is not about physical loss; it is about closing a door at the right time so another can open.
dai_13.y_nguoc: Reversed: the old thing is over but you still cling to it, and the long ending wears everyone out. Ask yourself: what am I keeping only because I fear the empty space?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A chapter of the relationship closes (a break-up, or the old way of being together has run its course). Sadness is right; dragging it out is not needed.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: The old work ends: leaving, changing field, closing a project. Clear up properly before starting the new thing.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Cut the loss, close unused accounts, drop old spending habits. Not the time to expand.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your body needs a change of routine: drop one draining habit. Go for your regular check-up to know the real numbers instead of fearing them; this card is not about illness.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Something has ended and you both still cling, and both of you are tired. Write down what you fear losing, then talk plainly about the next step.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The old work has lost its life and you haven't dared let go. List what needs handing over and set a closing date.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Still holding a loss or an old spending habit out of regret. Cut one expense you no longer use this week.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: You know which habit drains you and haven't dropped it yet. Reduce it bit by bit and keep your check-up to get real numbers.

dai_13.viec: Drop ONE thing that has outlived its use (a habit, an object, a recurring appointment) within 72 hours.
dai_13.cau_tu_soi: What in this situation ended long ago that you haven't yet allowed to end?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: this card favours closing what is finished over starting straight away. Clear up the old part first, then move on.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: that you let go of what is finished; the change is being held back. Check whether what you are holding is still of any use, then set a closing date.

dai_14.hinh_anh: An angel with one foot in the water and one on land pours water from one cup to another; a triangle inside a square marks the chest, and a path leads up to a shining crown.
dai_14.y_xuoi: The matter needs the right proportions: hot with cold, wanting with needing, work with rest. This card is about moderation and patience; nothing extreme, pour slowly until it is just right.
dai_14.y_nguoc: Reversed: too far to one side (working too much, eating too much, loving too much) or mixing two things that don't go together. Ask yourself: where am I out of rhythm?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Two people of different natures are learning to blend. It works if each gives a little; no rush.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Suits coordinating, reconciling two camps, healing a team. Steady progress, no sprints.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Moderate spending, spread evenly. Suits long plans; avoid pouring everything into one place.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your body thrives on moderation: eating, sleeping and moving in an even rhythm. If you tend to 'compensate' with food or drink, this card suggests easing off; keep your check-ups.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: One side gives way too much, or you push each other to extremes. Each of you steps back on one specific matter.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Working in bursts then dropping it, or pairing two tasks that don't fit. Rearrange the schedule into even daily portions.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Spending swings from too loose to too tight. Set a fixed weekly amount; anything over goes to next week.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Eating and sleeping are erratic, often made up for with food or drink. Return to a fixed bedtime and ease the compensating habit gradually.

dai_14.viec: Pick one thing that is 'too much' (work hours, coffee, messaging) - cut it by 20% for three days and note how you feel.
dai_14.cau_tu_soi: Which cup are you pouring too much into, and which one is running dry?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes, if you go gradually: this card suits a measured approach with adjustments along the way. Don't pour all your energy or money in at once.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, after you find a moderate rhythm again: something is being overdone or put in the wrong place. Trim the excess before you decide.

dai_15.hinh_anh: A goat-headed devil sits on a black pedestal; two figures stand below with loose chains around their necks - loose enough to slip off; a torch points downward.
dai_15.y_xuoi: There is a chain you put on yourself: a habit, a person, a fear, a way of earning. This card points at where the chain is loose; you can take it off, you just haven't wanted to look.
dai_15.y_nguoc: Reversed: you are starting to see the chain and loosen it. Ask yourself: what has the thing I 'can't give up' taught me about myself?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A relationship heavy with desire or dependence; a strong pull but exhausting. Set clear boundaries before you lose yourself.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: The job holds you by money or by fear of losing your seat; the environment has small temptations (small gains, small lies). Look at why you are still there.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Debt, small gambling, buying to fill a feeling. This card suggests stopping one spending habit and looking hard at any loan.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Draining habits (late nights, drink, screens) are steering you. Keep your check-up to get real numbers; if you need help, see a doctor.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You are starting to see where you depend too much in the relationship. Keep one small boundary you have stated and act exactly on it.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You have seen what binds you at work. Write out the other options and prepare step by step; no need to quit abruptly.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: You are gradually getting free of debt or emotional spending. Make a repayment schedule and don't borrow more.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: A draining habit is loosening its grip. Keep the momentum with a small daily action; if you need support, see a doctor.

dai_15.viec: Write the name of ONE habit or person that is 'holding' you; do one small thing to loosen it (one day without, one time saying no).

tra_loi.x: Not yet: check whether you truly want this, or whether temptation, fear or habit is pulling you along. If you find it hard to stop, that is the moment to slow down.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: go step by step. The card shows you have begun to see what binds you, but the old books also read it as a weak moment when the old habit returns easily. Act when you have a small plan and a trusted person to check in with.

dai_16.hinh_anh: Lightning knocks the crown off a tower on a rocky peak; fire bursts from the windows and two figures fall amid sparks of flame.
dai_16.y_xuoi: Something built on a false foundation is collapsing, and fast. This card is not comfortable, but it says: what falls is what was not real, and after the thunder you see more clearly. The task right now is to stay safe and not rebuild exactly as before.
dai_16.y_nguoc: Reversed: what ought to fall is being propped up at any cost, or the collapse has already passed and you are clearing up. Ask yourself: what am I holding up just because I fear the noise?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A truth in the relationship comes out; painful but clear. A big argument may be how the relationship sheds its old shell, or how it ends.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Sudden change at work (cutbacks, a new boss, a project falling through). Keep your records and don't sign anything while in shock.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: A risk of a sudden hit to your money; a financial plan coming apart. Now is the time to check your insurance and your cushion, not the time to gamble.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your body may be signalling with a small jolt (sleeplessness, a racing heart). For anything sudden, see a doctor right away instead of waiting on a reading.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Something that needs saying is being held down to keep the peace. Pick a calm moment and say part of it; don't wait for it to burst on its own.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: A big change is being postponed, or has just passed and needs clearing up. Sort your files, update your CV, and don't sign anything in a hurry.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: The old money plan is shaking and you keep trying to hold it. Review your insurance and reserve; don't borrow to prop it up.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Stress bottled up after an upheaval. Catch up on sleep at regular hours, and see a doctor if a racing heart or sleeplessness lingers.

dai_16.viec: For 72 hours: no big decisions; call someone you trust and tell what just broke in three sentences; get enough sleep.
dai_16.cau_tu_soi: Which 'tower' of yours is built on something you have always known isn't true?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: this card shows the foundation has a weak spot. Check the weakest point of the plan; if it can't stand, don't build on it.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you are willing to fix what is broken instead of propping it up. Face what has been shaken, deal with it first, then decide on the new thing.

dai_17.hinh_anh: A woman kneels by a pool, pouring water from two jugs onto the land and into the water beneath one large star and seven smaller ones; a bird perches in a distant tree.
dai_17.y_xuoi: After the storm comes a clear night: you are allowed to hope again, slowly and honestly. This card is about recovery, about refilling yourself, and about a far point to keep your eyes on.
dai_17.y_nguoc: Reversed: hope is thin, or hollow; you are running on empty while pretending to be fine. Ask yourself: who am I pouring for, and who pours for me?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Feelings are healing; trust returns bit by bit. Good for someone just out of a hard stretch; don't promise too soon.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Work has a clear direction in the distance; suits charity, research, meaningful work. Slow progress, but light.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Not much money yet, but enough and calm. A good time to pay down debt gradually and set a long-term goal.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your body is recovering: drink enough water, sleep enough, step outside in the evening air. Keep the load light; don't ramp up too fast.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Trust is still thin, or you hope for something with no basis. Look at what the other person does more than at what they promise.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You have lost heart for the far goal, or follow a lovely plan with no concrete steps. Set one small goal you can finish this week.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Easy to count on money that is 'about to come' with nothing on paper. Budget only with the money already in hand.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Energy is running out while you pretend to be fine. Cut back on tasks, drink enough water and go to bed early several nights in a row.

dai_17.viec: Each evening for three days, write one thing that went fine today - however small. Drink some water before bed.
dai_17.cau_tu_soi: Which star did you stop looking at when you got tired?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card shows a direction with real hope in it. Go slowly, keep the pace light, and don't promise anyone too soon.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: that the hope has a basis. Check whether you are relying on facts or just wishing. Rest and recover before you decide.

dai_18.hinh_anh: The moon looks down on a path running between two towers; a dog and a wolf howl, and a crayfish crawls up out of a pool.
dai_18.y_xuoi: Things are hazy: you see a lot, understand little, and fear is painting extra shapes. This card says: don't decide in the fog. Walk the path slowly, wait for daylight, and trust your true sense of things more than the shadows.
dai_18.y_nguoc: Reversed: the mist is lifting, fear is easing, what was hidden shows itself little by little. Ask yourself: which fear did I just discover wasn't real?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Many misunderstandings, groundless jealousy, things unsaid. Don't read into things; ask directly, or wait a little longer.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Information at work is unclear, with rumours around. Don't sign or decide yet; write everything down so you aren't swept along.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money has a blurry spot: an unclear amount, a promise with nothing on paper. Check carefully before you transfer anything.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Sleep and mood are up and down; notice vivid dreams and worry. If it lasts more than two weeks, see a doctor rather than guessing.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Misunderstandings are slowly being cleared and the unsaid is becoming clear. Choose a moment for an honest talk and keep your voice soft.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Information is clearing and rumours are dying down. Write down what has been confirmed and decide only on that.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: The blurry amount is becoming clear. Compare the statements again and ask right away about anything still unclear.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Sleep and mood are settling. Keep an even sleep rhythm; if the worry lingers, see a doctor.

dai_18.viec: Write your biggest fear about this as one sentence; next to it, list the evidence FOR and AGAINST. Do nothing else yet.

tra_loi.x: Not yet: too much is still unclear, and it is easy to decide from fear or imagination. Check the facts on paper, wait a little, then decide.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, once you have rechecked what was blurry: the mist is lifting. Confirm the key facts before you say yes.

dai_19.hinh_anh: A child rides a white horse with open arms beneath a sun with a human face, holding a red banner; sunflowers rise behind a wall.
dai_19.y_xuoi: Clear, warm, joyful: the matter is being seen exactly as it is, and it is good. This card is about honest success, vitality and a child's joy; nothing to hide.
dai_19.y_nguoc: Reversed: cheer on the surface, pride, or a glare that tires you out (doing too much, showing off too much). Ask yourself: am I truly happy, or acting happy?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Feelings are bright and clear and can be made public; children and family are warm. If you are looking, good news tends to be close.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Success, recognition, a project in the clear. Suits launching, presenting, signing; remember to share the credit.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money comes in plainly; income rises. Suits transparent plans; careful not to spend too generously.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Good vitality; get some morning sun and move outdoors. Protect your skin and eyes in strong sunlight; keep an early bedtime.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The joy is partly for show, or you tend to parade the relationship. Spend one evening together without photos, just talking.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Results are there but you risk complacency or taking all the credit. Name the people who helped and keep the quality up on the next piece.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Income is steady but spending is too generous. Set aside a share every time money comes in.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Easy to overdo it while on a high. Take breaks, cover up in the sun and keep your early bedtime.

dai_19.viec: Show off (in the good sense) one thing you just finished to one person - and thank someone who helped.
dai_19.cau_tu_soi: Which joy are you hiding for fear of looking like a show-off?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes, clearly: this card shows the matter bright and favourable. Still complete every step and share the credit with those who helped.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: don't overrate it. Check whether the plan rests on a passing burst of enthusiasm. Lower your expectations one notch, then do it.

dai_20.hinh_anh: An angel blows a trumpet from the clouds; adults and children rise from their coffins with open arms, and snowy mountains stand far off.
dai_20.y_xuoi: There is a call: to take stock of a stretch of road and rise up differently. This card is about looking back not to blame yourself but to see how much you have grown, and about forgiveness, for others and for yourself.
dai_20.y_nguoc: Reversed: you hear the call but haven't dared to stand up, or you judge yourself too harshly. Ask yourself: what crime am I putting myself on trial for?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A time to look back in the relationship: to forgive, to reconcile, or to decide firmly once things are clear. Decide by what you have learned.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A time for review and evaluation, or a change of direction that follows a real calling; old results are reconsidered.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Old matters get settled (debts, disputes, insurance). Close the books; make financial decisions by your new values.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your body is 'calling' through a signal that has repeated for a long time. This card suggests a general check-up to know the real numbers, then a change of routine.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You blame yourself or the other person too harshly over the past. Write down what you learned, then decide whether it needs saying again.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You know you need a change of direction but haven't dared, or you criticise yourself into standing still. Take one small trial step, such as enquiring at a new place.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: An old matter is being avoided. List the debts and unfinished business and settle the smallest one first.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Self-blame is costing you sleep. Rest at regular hours, and go for the general check-up if you have put it off for long.

dai_20.viec: Write a three-line letter of forgiveness (to someone or to yourself) about this - whether you send it is up to you.
dai_20.cau_tu_soi: Which call have you heard many times and kept saying 'later' to?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card backs a decision that has ripened after looking back. Check that you decide because you understood the old lesson, not because you are in a hurry.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: you are judging yourself harshly or still avoiding an old matter. Settle what is unfinished before deciding on the new thing.

dai_21.hinh_anh: A woman draped in a scarf dances inside a laurel wreath, a wand in each hand; four creatures look on from the clouds at the corners.
dai_21.y_xuoi: The matter is closing a full circle: completion, recognition, and the chance to go further. This card is about wholeness, and about celebrating before you open the next round.
dai_21.y_nguoc: Reversed: almost done but one piece is missing, or you fear the ending and so drag it out. Ask yourself: what is the missing piece, and who holds it?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: The relationship is ripe and whole and may move to a new stage (living together, travelling far together). It is enough; don't ask for more.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Finishing a large project, going abroad, reaching a wider market. Close, hand over, then rest a beat.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money from completed work; a large sum arriving. Suits expanding abroad, but close the old books first.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your body is in balance; suits travel and a change of climate. Keep your yearly check-up as a way of 'closing the circle'.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The relationship is near a new step but one matter is still unsettled. Name it and set a date to talk it through fully.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The project drags on for lack of the final step, or reluctance to hand over. List what is missing and fix a completion date.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Something is still not closed, or unfinished business is tying up money. Settle one item before opening a new one.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: A good habit was dropped halfway. Go back to the smallest piece of it regularly, and keep your yearly check-up.

dai_21.viec: Write down where this matter is already 'done'; send a thank-you or hand over one thing within 72 hours.
dai_21.cau_tu_soi: What have you already finished without allowing yourself to celebrate?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes, clearly: this matter has what it needs to be completed. Settle the final steps and keep your commitment until it is done.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: that you find the missing piece. Check which step is still unfinished or who hasn't agreed yet. Complete that part, then close.

gay_1.hinh_anh: A hand reaches out of a cloud holding a wand that is sprouting leaves; a small castle sits on a distant hill.
gay_1.y_xuoi: A new idea has just caught light, and it comes with the energy to begin. This card is the seed of a fire: not the result yet, just the wanting. Your job is to keep the flame alive with one small action today.
gay_1.y_nguoc: Reversed: the enthusiasm is there but burns out fast, or a good idea never turns into action. Ask yourself: am I short on energy, or short on a place to start?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A new attraction, or fresh excitement inside an old relationship; say out loud that you want to meet.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A new project or new idea; best to start while the excitement is still warm.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: A small outlay for something new; not the time to put everything in.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Energy is rising; a good moment to start exercising, but do not overdo the first day.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Interest flares and cools quickly, plans made and dropped; pick one concrete date and keep it.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The idea stays in your notebook; choose the smallest step you can do today and do it now.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: You want to spend on something new but are not clear what for; hold the money until you have a one-page plan.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: You start exercising and quit; set a small goal, fifteen minutes a day, and sleep enough before pushing harder.

gay_1.viec: Take the first step of the new idea within 24 hours — even if it is only opening a file and giving it a name.
gay_1.cau_tu_soi: Which idea is catching light in you that you have not dared to say out loud?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is an opening card, good for getting started while the excitement lasts. What to check: whether you have enough energy to keep going after the first week.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: the enthusiasm is there but has not become action. Try one small step first; if that step flows, then plan further.

gay_2.hinh_anh: A man holding a globe stands on a castle wall looking out to sea, one wand in his hand and another fixed beside the wall.
gay_2.y_xuoi: You already have a place to stand, and you are looking beyond it. This card is about planning and waiting on purpose: the world is in your hand, but you have not stepped out yet.
gay_2.y_nguoc: Reversed: the plan stays on paper; you are afraid to leave the safe spot. Ask yourself: what am I really waiting for?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: The relationship is steady but you want more; talk about shared plans instead of keeping them in your head.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Long-term planning, partnerships far away; a time to decide whether to go or stay.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: You have a base and are thinking of expanding; do not wait too long, and do not pour everything in.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm is steady; good for a long-term training plan, or a trip to change the scenery.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The two of you talk a lot about the future but do nothing; pick one shared thing to do this month.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The plan to change direction never gets settled; set a deadline to decide and write down what else you are waiting for.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Fear of leaving the safe spot keeps your money standing still; work out a small option and keep your reserve as it is.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: You want to change your routine but keep putting it off; change one small habit first, like going to bed half an hour earlier.

gay_2.viec: Write a three-step plan for the thing you want to expand; do step 1 this week.
gay_2.cau_tu_soi: Which wall are you standing on, and why have you not come down?

tra_loi.x: Yes, on a condition: you need a clear plan. This card shows you at a threshold of choice. Write down where you would go and what you lose by staying, then decide.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: you are hesitating to step out rather than missing the means. Ask yourself carefully what you are waiting for; if you cannot name it, this is not the moment.

gay_3.hinh_anh: A figure stands on a hill watching three ships at sea, with three wands planted around him.
gay_3.y_xuoi: Something you sent out is on its way back — trade, a partnership, news from afar. This card is about a vision that has become a road: hold your ground, wait in the right place, and plan the next step.
gay_3.y_nguoc: Reversed: the ships are slow, the plan is not going as expected, your view is blocked. Ask yourself: what have I sent out that has not come back?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Love at a distance, or waiting for word; good for someone widening their circle.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Expanding into new markets, import and export, working with outside partners; waiting for what you planted to bear fruit.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money is on its way back; what you put in is starting to produce; do not pull out early.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm needs a longer view: book check-ups and training by the quarter; walking and looking into the distance rests the eyes.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Long waits for news, or a long-distance relationship drifting off plan; ask directly once instead of guessing, then take care of your own rhythm.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Results you sent out are coming back late, partners miss deadlines; follow up in writing and prepare a second option.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Money you are waiting for is running late; do not spend what you have not received, and check the paperwork and payment dates.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Long-term plans have been left hanging; set one concrete check-up and training schedule for this quarter.

gay_3.viec: Send a greeting or a proposal to a person or partner far away within 72 hours.
gay_3.cau_tu_soi: Which 'ship' did you send out and then forget to track?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: the card shows that what you planted is on its way to bearing fruit. What to check: whether you can wait long enough without pulling out early.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: results are slow and your view is blocked. Review what you have already sent out before adding anything new.

gay_4.hinh_anh: Four wands hold up a garland of flowers; two people raise bouquets in greeting, with a castle behind them.
gay_4.y_xuoi: A milestone is done and there is ground to celebrate on: a home, a group, a ceremony, stability after a hard stretch. This card says: pause for a beat and enjoy it, then move on.
gay_4.y_nguoc: Reversed: it is still a milestone, but the joy is smaller, or things are settled while your heart is not at ease. Ask yourself: do I allow myself to rest?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Warm feelings, talk of moving in together, meeting the family, a ceremony; also good for making peace after a tense spell.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: The end of a phase, a handover, a team celebration; a stable base for the next step.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Enough money for a milestone (a home, a ceremony); spending on something shared fits, but set a limit.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm is steady; good for a short break, going home, eating with family; protect your sleep after the celebrations.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: A happy milestone but your heart is uneasy; say what still bothers you before planning more about a shared home.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: A phase is finished but it does not feel like a win; spend one session with the team acknowledging what was done.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: A smaller celebration than planned is still fine; keep your spending limit and do not borrow to make it bigger.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Settled but not truly rested; give yourself one day with no tasks, catch up on sleep, eat a home-cooked meal.

gay_4.viec: Arrange a small meal or a word of congratulations for something just finished — within three days.
gay_4.cau_tu_soi: Which milestone have you passed without celebrating it?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of a happy milestone on solid ground. What to check: whether this suits the people you live with.
tra_loi.n: Leans yes: it is still a happy milestone, only the joy is smaller than hoped. What to check: whether you have given yourself a rest, or are just getting it over with.

gay_5.hinh_anh: Five young men swing their wands at each other in a tangle; no one is hurt and no one wins.
gay_5.y_xuoi: Many people, many opinions, no one listening — clashing, but not yet hurting each other. This card is about competition and noise: what is needed is a set of rules, not a winner.
gay_5.y_nguoc: Reversed: conflict is avoided, peace is made, or you are worn out by an argument that drags on. Ask yourself: am I arguing to win, or to be heard?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Petty quarrels, jealousy, too many people getting involved; set ground rules for talking before discussing the issue.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Competition within the team, many opinions; good for contests and bidding; someone needs to coordinate.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money being fought over (splitting, bidding, pricing); do not decide while things are noisy.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm is disrupted; exercise to let off steam (boxing, running); give your ears a rest from the noise.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Small quarrels start to calm down, or the two of you avoid talking to avoid clashing; pick a calm moment to discuss one thing, not everything at once.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Arguments in the team die down, or everyone goes quiet from exhaustion; ask a coordinator to close the matter instead of dragging it out.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Disputes over splitting money or haggling over price have eased; write down what was agreed.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Worn out by long stress; cut back on noisy commitments, take relaxed walks, keep your bedtime.

gay_5.viec: For your most recent argument, write down what each side really wants (one line per person).
gay_5.cau_tu_soi: Who are you fighting with — and what are you fighting over?

tra_loi.x: Yes, on a condition: that you can handle competition, because the card shows many people contending. What to check: whether there are clear rules and someone to referee.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, now that the clashing has eased. What to check: whether you made peace because everything was said, or only because you were too tired to continue.

gay_6.hinh_anh: A rider wearing a laurel wreath, his wand also crowned with a wreath, while a crowd walks alongside.
gay_6.y_xuoi: A win that is seen: good news, recognition, being out in front. This card is about accepting praise properly — and remembering who walked behind you.
gay_6.y_nguoc: Reversed: you won but no one has acknowledged it, or pride came too early. Ask yourself: who am I winning for?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Good news in love, being chosen, being made public; remember to share the joy with the other person.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A promotion, a winning bid, recognition; good for job applications and presentations.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: A bonus or return arrives; good to receive, not yet good to spend it all.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Good energy, high spirits; be careful that confidence does not make you skip meals and sleep.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Good news not yet made public, or you need the other person's praise to feel settled; acknowledge yourself first, then say what you hope for.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You did well but no one has noticed; send a summary of the results to the people who need to know instead of waiting to be mentioned.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: The bonus has not arrived or is smaller than hoped; do not spend what you have not received, and check what was promised.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Overconfidence leads to skipped meals and late nights; keep the eating and sleeping rhythm you had before things got busy.

gay_6.viec: Publicly thank one person who contributed to the thing you just achieved.
gay_6.cau_tu_soi: The last time you won, who was walking behind you?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of victory and recognition. What to check: whether you are doing it because it is worth doing, or because you want to be seen.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: that you hold off on showing off, because the win is still temporary. Check who truly supports you and what is still unfinished before moving on.

gay_7.hinh_anh: A figure on a slope holds his wand against six wands striking up at him from below.
gay_7.y_xuoi: You are holding a high position that several sides want to take. This card is about the courage to stand by your position — and a reminder: defend what is worth defending, not everything.
gay_7.y_nguoc: Reversed: tired of being on the defensive, or giving up halfway. Ask yourself: what am I protecting, and is it still worth it?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Protecting the relationship from gossip; keep your boundaries with outsiders.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Holding your position against competition; standing up for your team; do not fight every battle.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Guarding what you have against many demands; say no to spending that is not needed.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your energy is being pulled in many directions; make sleep the priority; watch for tension in the shoulders and neck.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Tired of defending the relationship to so many people; ask yourself whether you still want to keep it, then tell the other person clearly.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: A long defence has worn you out and you want to quit midway; pick one battle worth fighting and let the small arguments go.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: So many demands that you want to let everything go; list what truly needs protecting and say no to the rest.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Long-held tension, aching shoulders and neck; take one real rest, and carry fewer loads for other people.

gay_7.viec: List the things you are 'holding on to'; cross out one that is no longer worth it and let it go.
gay_7.cau_tu_soi: What are you pushing against that really only needs you to stand still?

tra_loi.x: Yes, on a condition: that you are ready to stand firm, because the card shows you holding the high ground. What to check: whether this is worth defending against so many sides.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: you are worn out from being on the defensive. Rest to get your strength back and ask whether what you are holding is still worth it, then decide.

gay_8.hinh_anh: Eight wands fly diagonally across the sky, with a river and hills below.
gay_8.y_xuoi: Everything is moving fast: news arrives, things get done, a sudden trip. This card says: keep up with the pace and reply early — but read it over before you send.
gay_8.y_nguoc: Reversed: slow, stuck, or rushing and getting it wrong. Ask yourself: am I slow because something is blocking me, or because I do not really want this?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Messages, a confession, an unexpected meeting; things are moving fast — keep the pace honest.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Emails, news, business trips; work is speeding up, handle it in order.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money moving quickly (receiving, paying); check the numbers carefully before you press send.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: A hurried pace; good for travel and movement; remember to eat on time when busy.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Messages are slow, dates get pushed back, or hasty words cause misunderstanding; wait a beat, then say it again clearly, once.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Work is stuck, emails unanswered, or rushed and wrong; stop and check each step before sending anything further.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: A transfer is slow, or you sent it to the wrong place in a hurry; double-check account numbers and do not transfer while rushing.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm is thrown off by rushing then stalling; set fixed meal and bedtimes for this week.

gay_8.viec: Clear all the pending messages and emails about this matter in one sitting; send one message you have been putting off.
gay_8.cau_tu_soi: Which message are you waiting for that you could send first yourself?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: things are moving quickly and the door is open. What to check: whether you have enough information, because fast and incomplete often means redoing it.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: something is blocking you, or you are rushing and getting it wrong. Work out whether you are slow because of a real obstacle or because you do not want this, and clear that first.

gay_9.hinh_anh: A bandaged figure leans on his wand, eight wands planted behind him like a fence, glancing sideways on guard.
gay_9.y_xuoi: You have come almost all the way, carrying wounds, still on your feet. This card is about endurance and watchfulness — and a reminder: standing guard is needed, but if no one comes, lower the wand.
gay_9.y_nguoc: Reversed: out of strength, dug in, seeing everyone as an opponent. Ask yourself: what am I guarding, and is anyone actually coming?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Old hurts make you defensive; the relationship needs you to lower the fence one notch at a time.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: The final stretch of a project, which needs staying power; do not suspect your teammates; take a short rest and then finish.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Keep your reserve; your financial plan is almost complete, do not abandon it halfway.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your energy is nearly spent; schedule rest; watch for an old strain flaring up — see a doctor if it lingers.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: So defensive that everyone looks suspicious; tell one person you trust what you are worried about, instead of keeping it all in.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Out of strength in the final stretch, suspicious even of teammates; ask for help with part of the work, rest briefly, then continue.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Holding money tight out of worry, or too tired to keep to the plan; keep your reserve and postpone large purchases.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Energy nearly gone; sleep before pushing further, cut back this week, and go for a routine check-up if the tiredness lingers.

gay_9.viec: Stop work an hour early today; tomorrow finish the last step with one person helping.
gay_9.cau_tu_soi: What wound are you carrying while still standing guard?

tra_loi.x: Yes, on a condition: that you have the strength left to finish, because the card shows you close to the goal. What to check: whether you are getting enough rest to continue without overloading.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: you are out of strength and dug in. Recover, ask someone for help, then decide whether this is still worth finishing.

gay_10.hinh_anh: A figure bent double under ten wands walks towards a house nearby.
gay_10.y_xuoi: You are carrying too much — most of it things you took on yourself. This card is about the load and about being almost home: put some of it down and you get there faster.
gay_10.y_nguoc: Reversed: you start to put things down, share the work, or the load collapses. Ask yourself: of these ten wands, how many belong to someone else?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: One person carries the whole relationship; it needs sharing — say clearly where you are tired.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Overloaded, hoarding tasks, not delegating; hand off two tasks this week.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Debts, financial responsibility for many people; sort out your repayment priorities.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Exhaustion, back and shoulder pain from the load; take a real rest, see a doctor if the pain lingers; do not just 'push on'.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You begin to share housework and shared duties; say clearly which part you need the other person to take.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You have managed to hand off some work, or the load got too heavy and collapsed; list what belongs to others and return it to them.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Financial responsibilities start to lighten; reorder your repayments and do not borrow more to carry other people's loads.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: You are putting down some of the load; give yourself a real rest, sleep enough, and stretch gently each evening.

gay_10.viec: Delegate or drop TWO tasks from this week's list; tell one person that you need help.
gay_10.cau_tu_soi: Which wand are you carrying only because no one told you to put it down?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: do not take on more, you are already carrying too much. It can be done if you first drop or hand off two things.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: that you truly set down part of the load, because the reversed card shows the weight easing. What to check: whether the new thing would add more to your shoulders.

gay_tieu_dong.hinh_anh: A young person holds a wand and gazes at its leaves, wearing a tunic printed with salamanders, standing in a desert with pyramids in the distance.
gay_tieu_dong.y_xuoi: Good news, a new interest, or an enthusiastic young person appears. This card is fire still learning: curious, excited, not yet sure-handed — go ahead and try, but see one thing through to the end.
gay_tieu_dong.y_nguoc: Reversed: impulsive enthusiasm, good news running late, things left unfinished. Ask yourself: am I trying many things so I never have to get good at one?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: An opening message, an invitation; young, fun feelings, not yet serious.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: An internship, learning a new job, a bold proposal; good for beginnings, needs a mentor.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Good news about a small sum; do not spend on impulse.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Youthful energy; good for a new sport; warm up properly to avoid injury.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: A message arrives late, or interest in someone new cools off; wait a little before making promises.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You try many things and leave them unfinished; pick one to learn properly and ask someone to mentor you.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Happy news about money that is not yet certain; impulse spending leaves you short, so write down every expense this week.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: You take up a new sport and drop it; keep one activity regular and warm up properly before training.

gay_tieu_dong.viec: Try one small thing you have long been curious about (a class, a lesson, a phone call) — today.
gay_tieu_dong.cau_tu_soi: What are you excited about — and can you keep it up for 21 days?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of news and invitations. What to check: whether someone experienced can guide you at the start.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: the enthusiasm is still impulsive and the good news has not arrived. Wait for more information and try small before committing.

gay_tieu_dong.nhan_vat: An enthusiastic young person who loves to start things and gets bored easily; a bringer of news and new ideas.

gay_hiep_si.hinh_anh: An armoured knight on a rearing horse, his tunic marked with salamanders, holds a wand against a desert background.
gay_hiep_si.y_xuoi: Charging forward, fast and hot — a journey, or someone arriving like a gust of wind. This card is about the passion to act: good for setting out, poor for things that need patience.
gay_hiep_si.y_nguoc: Reversed: impatient, leaving things unfinished, running into other people. Ask yourself: am I charging ahead because I want to arrive, or because I cannot bear standing still?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Someone arrives fast and passionate, and tends to leave; lots of excitement, little staying; say clearly what you want.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Business travel, changing jobs, urgent projects; good for anyone who needs a push; someone has to keep the pace steady.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Spending on travel and risks; be careful of impulse buying.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Strong but prone to overload; watch for injuries when rushing; slow down when driving.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Feelings that rush in and then stop; say clearly what you want before planning anything further.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Changing jobs on a whim, dropping a project halfway; write down why you want to change and what is unfinished before you go.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Impulse purchases, spending on a sudden trip; set a limit and wait a day before any large expense.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Rushing makes you overdo it; slow down when driving, warm up properly, sleep enough.

gay_hiep_si.viec: Do the most urgent item on your list first thing tomorrow morning, then stop and check whether it was the right thing to do.
gay_hiep_si.cau_tu_soi: Where are you running to — and who is running after you?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of fast moves, changing places, setting out. What to check: whether someone can keep pace with you so nothing is left unfinished.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: you are charging ahead because you cannot stand still. Work out where you want to end up and what is still unfinished, then go.

gay_hiep_si.nhan_vat: A fast, passionate person who is always on the move and short on patience.

gay_hoang_hau.hinh_anh: A queen sits on a throne with lion heads, holding a wand and a sunflower, with a black cat at her feet.
gay_hoang_hau.y_xuoi: Warm, confident, in charge of her own affairs while staying friendly. This card is about natural charm: knowing what you want and making others want it too.
gay_hoang_hau.y_nguoc: Reversed: jealous, hot-tempered, hard to please; or losing confidence and withdrawing. Ask yourself: am I in charge, or am I controlling?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A warm, attractive person; the relationship needs confidence, not jealousy; take the lead in making plans.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A friendly leader; good for looking after clients and leading a team; do not take on everyone's work.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Confident with money, knows how to spend on beautiful things; be careful of being too generous.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Good energy, active; watch your digestion when eating and drinking for social reasons; keep your sleep rhythm.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Jealousy or fussiness rising, or you withdraw into yourself; say what worries you in short sentences and check up on the other person less.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Taking on the whole team's work, or losing confidence when presenting; hand one task back and prepare your key points well.
