linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Spending to prove something, or anxiously holding on tight; look at your latest expense and ask whether it was a need or a wish to be seen.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Running hot when under stress; cut afternoon coffee, take walks, go to bed on time.

gay_hoang_hau.viec: Take the initiative to invite or host a small get-together this week — you are the one who calls.
gay_hoang_hau.cau_tu_soi: When do you feel warmest towards other people?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of a confident, warm person who is in charge of her affairs. What to check: whether you have enough people working with you, rather than carrying it all.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: that you lead rather than control, because this card reversed often goes with jealousy or lost confidence. Look at why you want to do this first.

gay_hoang_hau.nhan_vat: A warm, confident person with natural charm; prone to jealousy when confidence slips.

gay_vua.hinh_anh: A king sits on a throne carved with lions and salamanders, holding a wand and looking to the side, in a cloak the colour of fire.
gay_vua.y_xuoi: Someone who leads through vision and decisiveness — it may be you, or someone you need to meet. This card is about being at the head: choosing the direction, owning the results, and leaving room for others.
gay_vua.y_nguoc: Reversed: domineering, hot-tempered, expecting too much of yourself and others. Ask yourself: am I leading, or am I pushing?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A strong, decisive person; the relationship needs you to give the other person the floor; do not turn your home into a company.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A director, business owner, project leader; good for big decisions; remember to listen before deciding.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money from business, taken in hand; be careful of risky decisions made out of confidence.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Strong energy; keep an eye on your blood pressure and your temper; sleep enough even when busy.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Wanting everything your own way; ask what the other person thinks first, then give your view.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Pushing the team to meet expectations that are too high; bring the target down to what can be done and listen before closing the decision.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Money decisions driven by ego; ask someone knowledgeable, check the numbers, and do not borrow more out of confidence.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Short temper, long-running stress; practise slow breathing, sleep enough, keep up routine check-ups.

gay_vua.viec: Close ONE decision that has been discussed for more than two weeks; tell the people involved in three sentences.
gay_vua.cau_tu_soi: Who are you leading — and have you asked them where they want to go?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of a leader who dares to decide. What to check: whether you have listened enough to the people involved.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: that you change your approach first, because the reversed card shows pushing more than leading. It can be done if you lower your expectations and listen to the people working with you.

gay_vua.nhan_vat: A decisive leader with vision; becomes domineering under strain.

coc_1.hinh_anh: A hand reaching out of a cloud holds a cup overflowing with water; a dove carrying a small wafer flies down, and lotus flowers float on the pond below.
coc_1.y_xuoi: Your heart is opening: a new feeling, a sense of being loved, or your intuition speaking up. This card is a drop of water that wants to overflow. Let it, instead of putting a lid on it.
coc_1.y_nguoc: Reversed: the cup is empty or turned over. Feelings are held in and it is hard to open up. Ask yourself: what feeling am I keeping to myself right now?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: The start of a feeling, a sense of being loved. A good time to say how you feel or to make peace.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Work that suits the heart: creating, caring, the arts. A warm team around you.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money that comes from doing what you enjoy. Giving a little is also a way of receiving.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Steady feelings help the body stay steady. Drink enough water and get enough sleep.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Hard to open up; feelings are held in. Write down what you want to say, then pick one sentence and say it honestly.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You work without joy and the spark has run dry. Find one part of the job you used to enjoy and do that first.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Spending to fill an empty feeling. Note down what you buy when you feel low, and put off the purchase until tomorrow.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Held-in feelings wear the body down. Sleep enough, drink enough water, and talk to someone you trust.

coc_1.viec: Say or text one honest sentence to someone you care about — today.
coc_1.cau_tu_soi: What is your heart full of right now?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of a beginning that comes from the heart. One thing to check: do you truly want this yourself, or only for someone else?
tra_loi.n: Not yet: your heart is closed or running dry. Let the feelings settle, name what you actually want, and decide after that.

coc_2.hinh_anh: A man and a woman hold out their cups to each other; above them rises a winged staff entwined by two snakes, topped with a lion's head.
coc_2.y_xuoi: Two sides are meeting in the middle: a relationship or a partnership where both give and both receive. This card is about balance between two people, each holding their own cup.
coc_2.y_nguoc: Reversed: one side gives more than the other; small quarrels and misunderstandings pile up. Ask yourself: am I giving more, or receiving more?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Feelings flow both ways. A good time to open up or to make peace; the two of you understand each other.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A two-way partnership with a colleague you get on with. A small agreement can be signed.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Shared money between two people. Split things clearly; a small joint venture can pay off.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: A rhythm you can keep together with someone. Mind how you eat alongside the other person; you do not have to match them.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: One side gives more; small misunderstandings. Each of you says one thing you need, and you listen to the end before replying.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The partnership is out of step and the work piles up on one side. Go over who does what, and write it down.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Shared money with no clear owner. Sit down together and set out who contributes what and who pays for what.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm has drifted to match the other person's. Keep the sleep and meal times that suit you.

coc_2.viec: Have a 20-minute conversation with the most important person in this matter, phones away.
coc_2.cau_tu_soi: Who are you handing your cup to, and are they handing one back?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of two sides moving the same way. One thing to check: does the other person truly agree, or are they just nodding to get it over with?
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: the balance has to be restored. The reversed card shows one side leaning too far. Say clearly what each of you gives and receives before moving on.

coc_3.hinh_anh: Three women raise their cups and dance together in a garden full of ripe fruit.
coc_3.y_xuoi: Shared joy: friends, a group, a celebration, good news passed around. This card is about the strength of a small community. You are not walking alone.
coc_3.y_nguoc: Reversed: the party goes too far, you lose yourself in the crowd, or a third person steps in. Ask yourself: who am I truly celebrating with, and who am I just standing next to?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Joy with friends around you: gatherings, celebrations, meeting people.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A shared result for the team; a launch or a celebration. Good for working in a group.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money spent on get-togethers. Keep it moderate; if you pool money, keep it clear.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Joy helps you stay well. Watch what you eat and drink at parties, and get your sleep back on track afterwards.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You feel lost in the crowd, or a third person is getting between you. Make time for just the two of you and say clearly where the line is.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Lots of gatherings but the work moves slowly, or you feel lost in the team. Pick one person you work well with and pair up.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Overspending on nights out. Set a limit for social events, and write down anything you chip in.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Too many parties throw off your sleep and meals. Skip one event, go to bed early, and drink more water.

coc_3.viec: Invite two friends to meet up or have a video call within the next three days.
coc_3.cau_tu_soi: When was the last time you felt joy together with other people?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of shared joy, with friends behind you. One thing to check: do the people around you want this as well?
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: step away from the crowd first. The reversed card shows the fun has gone too far or you are being swept along. Ask what you want, apart from what others are saying.

tu_khoa: not seeing the cup being offered
coc_4.hinh_anh: A person sits under a tree with arms folded, three cups in front of them, while a hand from a cloud offers a fourth cup that they do not look at.
coc_4.y_xuoi: You are bored and not seeing what is being handed to you. This card is about indifference: it is not that there is nothing there, but that you are looking inward.
coc_4.y_nguoc: Reversed: you wake up, take the new cup, and the boredom lifts. Ask yourself: what did I just turn down without looking at it properly?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Boredom in the relationship; you do not notice the other person's efforts. Look again at the fourth cup.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Bored with the job and blind to the chance in front of you. Change your angle before you change jobs.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money is fine, yet it feels like not enough. Look again at what you expect.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Tired because you do not feel like doing anything. Step outside for a while. If the low mood lasts several weeks, talk to a doctor.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You are waking up after a dull stretch and noticing the other person's efforts. Say one specific thank-you.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You are starting to see the chance in front of you. Take on one new task for a month before talking about moving.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: On a second look, you have more than you thought. Write down what you have and pick one small goal.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: The sluggishness is lifting. Get outside every day, keep your sleep times, and talk to a doctor if the low mood drags on.

coc_4.viec: List three things already present in this matter that you are so used to you no longer notice them.

tra_loi.x: Not yet: you are bored, so you tend to wave things away or say yes just for a change of scene. Look closely at the offer in front of you before you answer.
tra_loi.n: Leans yes: the reversed card is the moment of waking up and taking the new cup. One thing to check: have you read the terms of the offer properly?

coc_5.hinh_anh: A figure in a black cloak stands with head bowed over three spilled cups, two cups still standing behind them; a bridge crosses the river to a castle.
coc_5.y_xuoi: Something was lost and you are staring at the three spilled cups. This card does not tell you not to grieve. It only reminds you that two cups still stand behind you, and the bridge is still there.
coc_5.y_nguoc: Reversed: you begin to turn around, notice what is left, and cross the bridge. Ask yourself: have I grieved enough, or am I staying sad so I do not have to move?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Missing a relationship, feeling regret. Let yourself be sad, then look at the two cups that remain.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A project failed or a chance was missed. Take the lesson and hold on to the two things that are left.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money lost. Write down the lesson, and do not try to win it back with a risky move.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Sadness tires the body. Eat and sleep properly even when you do not feel like it. If the sadness lasts several weeks, see a doctor.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You are starting to stop missing what was lost and to look at what remains. Meet someone close to you and tell them what happened.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You have accepted that the project failed and are picking up the parts you can still use. Write three lessons, then start a small task.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Stop staring at the lost amount. Check what you still have, keep a cushion, and do not chase the loss with a risky move.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm starts to return. Eat and sleep regularly, walk outside, and see a doctor if the sadness drags on.

coc_5.viec: Write down three things that remain after this (a person, a skill, a lesson); do one thing with one of them.
coc_5.cau_tu_soi: What are the two cups behind you?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: you are looking at what was lost. Let the regret settle, name what remains, and only then decide on the new thing.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you have stopped looking back: the reversed card is the moment of crossing the bridge. One thing to check: are you deciding because you want to move on, or to forget quickly?

coc_6.hinh_anh: An older child hands a cup full of flowers to a smaller one in the courtyard of an old house.
coc_6.y_xuoi: Memories, simple kindness, a trip back home, someone from the past. This card is about the sweetness of what was: good for drawing strength from, not good for staying in.
coc_6.y_nguoc: Reversed: stuck in nostalgia, too naive, or someone from the past returns at the wrong time. Ask yourself: do I miss what happened, or do I miss who I was back then?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: An old flame, a first love, something warm from long ago; making peace through shared memories. Careful not to paint the past rosy.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Returning to an old place; a former colleague helps. Good for work with children or in education.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money from gifts or family; giving away a small amount; an inheritance.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Look after your body the way you would a child: sleep, play, get some sun. Notice which habits from childhood still shape you today.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Stuck in an old story, or an old flame returns at the wrong time. Compare the person in front of you with who they are now, not with who they were.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You keep going back to the old way of doing things. Keep the part that still works and try one new method this week.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Spending for the sake of memories, or counting on money from family. Set a budget based on what you earn today.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Holding on to old routines that no longer fit. Change one sleep or eating habit to suit the age you are now.

coc_6.viec: Call an old friend or visit an old place this week; afterwards, write down what you brought back to the present.
coc_6.cau_tu_soi: Which memory gives you strength, and which one holds you back?

tra_loi.x: Yes, on a condition: this has to suit who you are today, not just the longing. This is the card of warm memories. One thing to check: are you painting the past rosy?
tra_loi.n: Not yet: you are looking through the eyes of the past. See this matter as it is today, as the person you are now, and then decide.

coc_7.hinh_anh: A shadowy figure stands before seven cups floating on a cloud, each holding something: a head, a veiled shape, a snake, a castle, jewels, a wreath, a dragon.
coc_7.y_xuoi: Too many options, and many of them are only clouds. This card is about daydreaming: enjoying the pictures is fine, but only when you pick one real cup can you drink from it.
coc_7.y_nguoc: Reversed: you wake from the dream, choose one, and come back down to earth. Ask yourself: which cup holds water, and which is only cloud?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Several admirers, or many fantasies about one person. The feelings have not touched the ground yet.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Many directions and ideas flying around. Pick one and test it for 30 days.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Promises of 'easy' money and lots of offers. Check the facts before you trust any of them.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Dreamy and forgetful about meals and sleep. Keep the body's rhythm simple; do not try every method at once.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Waking from the pictures in your head about the other person. Look at what they actually do and pick one real thing to say.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You have picked one direction out of many. Test it for thirty days and cross the other ideas off the list.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: You see that the easy-money offers are clouds. Hold on to your money and act only on numbers you have checked.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Drop the scattered trials of diets and workouts. Keep one simple routine and go to bed on time.

coc_7.viec: Write down the seven options you have; cross out all but ONE; take the first step of that one within 72 hours.
coc_7.cau_tu_soi: Which cup do you prefer to look at rather than drink from?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: many options are in front of you, and many are only wishes. Check each one against the facts, then pick one.
tra_loi.n: Leans yes: the reversed card is the moment of waking up and choosing something real. One thing to check: the option should come with figures, not just promises.

coc_8.hinh_anh: A figure with a staff walks away up the mountain under the moon, leaving eight cups neatly stacked behind.
coc_8.y_xuoi: You are leaving something that was enough but no longer feeds you. This card is about walking away on purpose: not angry at anyone, just going to look for something deeper.
coc_8.y_nguoc: Reversed: afraid to leave, or leaving to escape rather than to seek. Ask yourself: am I going to find something, or going to hide?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Leaving a relationship that has run dry even though no one is at fault; or stepping back for a while to see it clearly.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Leaving a stable but meaningless job; turning towards something deeper. Prepare before you go.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Giving up a steady income to do something else. You need a cushion of at least three months.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: A need to go away and change the air. Watch your mood when you leave what is familiar; get enough sleep.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Afraid to leave even though it has run dry, or leaving to avoid a conversation. Ask yourself what you are looking for, and say it honestly before stepping back.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Wanting to quit to escape the pressure, or staying forever out of fear. Write down what you are looking for in a new place.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Staying out of fear of losing the pay cheque, or leaving with no cushion. Work out three months of expenses first.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Running from tiredness by getting busier. Take a short rest where you are, sleep enough, and only then plan the trip away.

coc_8.viec: Pick one 'good enough' thing that is holding you; write down the deeper thing you are looking for; schedule the first step of leaving.
coc_8.cau_tu_soi: What are you staying in only because it is not bad?

tra_loi.x: Yes, on a condition: you are leaving something that has run dry to look for something deeper. The card leans towards the step. One thing to check: have you prepared enough so you do not leave empty-handed?
tra_loi.n: Not yet: you are afraid to leave, or you want to leave in order to hide. Name what you are looking for; until you can, hold off on the decision.

coc_9.hinh_anh: A man sits with arms folded and a satisfied smile, nine cups arranged in an arc on the shelf behind him.
coc_9.y_xuoi: A wish has come true in an everyday way: fed, comfortable, praised. This card is about contentment, and it asks gently: now that you have enough, will you share?
coc_9.y_nguoc: Reversed: full but hollow, smug, or wanting even more. Ask yourself: I have enough, so why do I still feel I am missing something?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Happiness; a wish about love has come true. Careful not to get so comfortable that you stop tending to it.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Results in hand and satisfaction with where you are. Do not sit still too long.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Enough money; a bonus arrives. Enjoy it in moderation and put some aside.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Feeling well and eating well. Watch for overdoing food and drink, and keep up light, regular exercise.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You have enough yet still feel something missing, or you have grown comfortable and stopped tending to it. Do one small thing for the other person this week.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: So satisfied you have stalled, or always wanting more. Set one goal within reach for the coming quarter.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Wanting to spend more even though you have enough. Put off the big purchase for a week and save the bonus that just came in.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Overdoing food and drink when celebrating. Cut one drinking session, keep light regular exercise, and keep your sleep times.

coc_9.viec: Give or share one thing (a meal, a compliment, a small amount) with someone less fortunate this week.
coc_9.cau_tu_soi: Which of your wishes has already come true without you noticing?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of a wish fulfilled and contentment. One thing to check: does this give you what you need, or only add to what you already have?
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if it is not just wanting more: the reversed card is full but hollow. Ask whether you want this because something is truly missing, or because you have not yet noticed you have enough.

coc_10.hinh_anh: A family raises their arms beneath a rainbow of ten cups; two children dance holding hands, with a house and a river in the distance.
coc_10.y_xuoi: Shared happiness: a family in harmony, a peaceful home, a full heart. This is the overflowing cup of the suit, reminding you that the greatest joy is the joy you have company in.
coc_10.y_nguoc: Reversed: trouble at home, happiness only on the surface, family expectations weighing you down. Ask yourself: who at home is unhappy that I have not asked yet?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Family happiness, a wedding, children. A good time to go home and gather everyone.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A team that feels like family; work that fits your home values. Keep the balance between work and home.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Enough money for the household; buying a home together. Spending on family fits the moment.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: A peaceful home helps you stay well. Eat meals at home, and look after the older people in the family: take them for a check-up.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Trouble at home behind a happy front. Ask each person at home, one on one, what they need, and listen before you give advice.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Work is pulling you away from the family table. Set a fixed time to be home two days a week.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Family expectations are weighing on your finances. Say clearly what you can cover, and do not borrow more to save face.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Tension at home is costing you sleep. Find a quiet corner for yourself, and take the older family members for a regular check-up.

coc_10.viec: Organise a family meal or a call with the whole family within three days; ask each person about one thing that is making them happy.
coc_10.cau_tu_soi: Is your family truly happy, or happy for the photo?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of a peaceful home and shared happiness. One thing to check: do the people at home want this too?
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: the family has to talk to each other first. The reversed card shows happiness on the surface. Ask each person what they think before you decide.

coc_tieu_dong.hinh_anh: A young person in a flowered tunic stands by the seashore, holding a cup with a fish poking its head out.
coc_tieu_dong.y_xuoi: News about a feeling, a poetic idea, a flash of intuition, like the fish popping out of the cup. This card is water still learning: sensitive, dreamy, easily moved.
coc_tieu_dong.y_nguoc: Reversed: too dreamy, too sensitive, news that arrives late. Ask yourself: am I feeling this, or imagining that I feel it?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A sweet message, an invitation, a feeling that is still young. A good time to express yourself gently.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Creative ideas and work that needs intuition. Learning a trade connected to the arts or to caring for others.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: News of a small amount of money. Do not spend on impulse.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Sensitive, and tiredness follows your mood. Drink enough water, and write your feelings down instead of holding them in.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You dream about the other person more than you actually know them. Meet and talk a few times before pinning big hopes on it.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Plenty of creative ideas but no finished product. Make one small draft and send it to one person for feedback.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Money news arrives late, or you buy on feeling. Wait for the money to land before spending, and note down what you buy when you feel low.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Sensitive, and tired according to your mood. Write a few lines in a journal, drink enough water, and go to bed early.

coc_tieu_dong.viec: Write three lines about what you feel about this matter; send one of them to the person involved.
coc_tieu_dong.cau_tu_soi: Which fish has just popped out of your cup?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of a gentle invitation and small good news. One thing to check: have you tested this feeling against something real?
tra_loi.n: Not yet: the reversed card shows you are imagining more than you know. Wait for more news and check it against reality before you step forward.

coc_tieu_dong.nhan_vat: A dreamy, sensitive young person who often brings news about matters of the heart.

coc_hiep_si.hinh_anh: A knight in fish-patterned armour rides slowly on a white horse across a river, holding out a cup.
coc_hiep_si.y_xuoi: An offer made from the heart: a proposal, an invitation, a romantic idea. This card is about following your feelings: slow, lovely, and in need of a little more honesty.
coc_hiep_si.y_nguoc: Reversed: empty promises, romance used to win favour, dreams that never turn into action. Ask yourself: do these fine words come with any action?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A declaration of love, a proposal, a romantic person arriving. A good time to express yourself.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A partnership offer built on goodwill; the arts. Check the terms behind the fine words.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money promised through a relationship. Until it is on paper, do not count on it.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: A slow rhythm; rest near water suits you. Mind your digestion when you eat according to your mood.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Fine words with no action behind them yet. Watch how the other person keeps their promises over the next few weeks.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: An attractive offer with vague terms. Ask for a clear written document before you accept.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Money promised through a relationship. Until it is on paper, do not count on it, and do not lend out of sentiment.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Living on whims, with meals and sleep out of step. Keep a simple routine, walk near water, and go to bed on time.

coc_hiep_si.viec: Make one specific invitation (day, time, activity) to someone you care about within 72 hours.
coc_hiep_si.cau_tu_soi: Which fine words have you said but not yet acted on?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of an invitation or an offer drawing near. One thing to check: the offer should come with specific terms, not just fine words.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: the reversed card often travels with empty promises. Ask for something in writing or wait for real action before you agree.

coc_hiep_si.nhan_vat: A romantic who makes offers from the heart; when off balance, they slide into empty promises.

coc_hoang_hau.hinh_anh: A queen sits on a throne at the water's edge, gazing at a lidded cup decorated with two angels.
coc_hoang_hau.y_xuoi: Someone who understands other people's feelings without losing herself; it may be you, or someone who is helping you. This card is about mature intuition and care that keeps its boundaries.
coc_hoang_hau.y_nguoc: Reversed: worrying too much, dependence, drowning in other people's feelings. Ask yourself: am I caring, or am I carrying?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A gentle, understanding person. The relationship needs you to stay yourself while you look after the other person.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Caring, counselling, or creative work. Lead the team by listening.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money spent generously on loved ones. Keep a part for yourself.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Sensitive to the atmosphere around you; you need quiet, water, and sleep. Notice how your mood moves in cycles.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Looking after the other person until you forget yourself. Set one small boundary: keep one evening a week just for you.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Carrying the feelings of the whole team. Listen within limits, and pass the hard cases to the right person.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Spending too freely on loved ones. Set aside a portion for yourself first, and give from what is left.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Worn out from being soaked in other people's troubles. Sleep enough, take in less sad news, and go for a walk alone.

coc_hoang_hau.viec: Ask someone close to you 'how have you been lately?' and only listen for 15 minutes, with no advice.
coc_hoang_hau.cau_tu_soi: Are you carrying feelings that belong to someone else?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of someone who understands and knows how to listen. One thing to check: can you do this and still keep your strength while looking after others?
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: you keep your boundaries. The reversed card shows you are carrying instead of caring. First ask whether this matter is yours or someone else's.

coc_hoang_hau.nhan_vat: A gentle, empathetic carer; when off balance, they slide into worry and dependence.

coc_vua.hinh_anh: A king sits on a throne in the middle of the sea, holding a cup and a sceptre, with a ship and a dolphin behind him.
coc_vua.y_xuoi: Staying calm amid the waves: a steady, forgiving person who knows their feelings without being swept away by them. This card is about the heart grown mature.
coc_vua.y_nguoc: Reversed: feelings pushed down, coldness, or feelings used to control others. Ask yourself: am I truly calm, or just holding it in?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A mature, generous person. The relationship needs you to say what you have been holding back.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A calm manager; counselling and mediation. Careful about keeping everything to yourself.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money is steady. Lending out of affection needs paperwork: generous, but clear.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Keep a steady rhythm. Notice when you push feelings down with food or drink; go for regular check-ups.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Holding feelings in, or using silence to keep the upper hand. Say one thing you have been keeping inside, in an ordinary voice.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: A calm face over a tense inside. Write down what is bothering you and talk it over with the people involved.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Lending out of obligation, or hiding money matters. Put every loan, given or taken, down on paper.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Pushing feelings down with food and late nights. Find a healthy outlet such as walking or writing, and go for regular check-ups.

coc_vua.viec: Tell someone about one thing you have been keeping inside for more than a month.
coc_vua.cau_tu_soi: What are you holding down beneath the calm?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this is the card of a calm person who weighs things carefully. One thing to check: decide with both head and heart, without pushing down what still feels wrong.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: the reversed card shows feelings being pushed down or used to pressure. Say what is still bothering you before you decide.

coc_vua.nhan_vat: A calm, generous adviser; when off balance, they slide into suppression or manipulation.

kiem_1.hinh_anh: A hand reaches out of a cloud holding a sword upright; a crown with a laurel branch and a palm branch rests on its tip.
kiem_1.y_xuoi: One clear thought cuts through the tangle: a truth, a decision, the right words said plainly. This card is the seed of the mind at its sharpest. Use that edge where it belongs, not everywhere.
kiem_1.y_nguoc: Reversed: your head feels muddled, the words come out wrong, or they are sharp enough to hurt. Ask yourself: am I being clear, or am I just being harsh?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Say one true thing. The relationship needs clarity now; just watch how sharp the words get.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A fresh idea, a clear decision, an argument you can win on merit. Good for reasoning and writing.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: A clear money decision: cut one expense, and read the fine print before you agree to anything.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your mind is alert. Pay attention to your breathing and your lungs, and do not let worrying eat into your sleep.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Words are coming out sharp before the meaning is clear, and they can wound. Before a big conversation, write what you really want to say in one sentence.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The idea is still tangled, and it is tempting to argue to win rather than to understand. Split the problem into three bullet points before you present it.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: A money decision is being rushed or built on wrong information. Reread the terms, ask one more person, and do not sign yet.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Your head is overloaded: lots of thinking, no clear result. Write tomorrow's tasks on paper before bed and switch off screens half an hour earlier.

kiem_1.viec: Write ONE sentence about what you have decided in this matter; read it aloud; send it to the person involved if needed.
kiem_1.cau_tu_soi: What have you already seen clearly but not yet dared to say in a full sentence?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card backs a clear decision. The condition is that you can give your reason in one sentence and are willing to be honest with the people involved.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: your head is still muddled, and the reasoning is sharp but not clear. Check your information again and wait until you can explain it without snapping.

kiem_2.hinh_anh: A blindfolded figure sits holding two swords crossed over the chest, with the sea and a crescent moon behind.
kiem_2.y_xuoi: You are holding two swords in perfect balance and keeping your eyes covered so you do not have to choose. This card is about a truce: needed for a while, but your arms get tired.
kiem_2.y_nguoc: Reversed: the blindfold has to come off, a decision arrives, something hidden comes to light. Ask yourself: am I not choosing because I do not know enough, or because I am afraid?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Standing in the middle, avoiding the talk. The relationship is waiting for you to open your eyes.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Postponing a decision to keep the peace. Gather a limited amount of extra information, then set a date to choose.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Holding steady, neither opening nor closing anything. Give the decision a deadline.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Tight shoulders and held breath. Practise breathing, take off the blindfold, and book an eye check if it has been a while.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The thing you have been avoiding now has to be said. Pick a calm moment, say what you see in short sentences, and do not assign blame.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: No more postponing: the decision has to be made, and what was hidden tends to come out. Collect the missing information within a few days, then choose.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: A sum of money left hanging now needs handling. List two options with real numbers, pick the less risky one, and do not borrow more to stretch it out.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Tension you have held in for a long time is asking for release. Tell one worry to someone you trust and go to bed on time for several nights in a row.

kiem_2.viec: Write down your two options and a deadline you set yourself for choosing; tell one person that date.
kiem_2.cau_tu_soi: What are you covering your eyes so that you do not have to see?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: you are blindfolded, avoiding one side of the matter. Take the blindfold off first by gathering the missing information and setting yourself a date to choose.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, on the condition that you look straight at what you fear. The reversed card pushes you to the point of choosing; choose on information, not because you feel cornered.

kiem_3.hinh_anh: A red heart pierced by three swords, with rain and grey clouds behind it.
kiem_3.y_xuoi: Pain, often from words or from a truth laid bare. This card does not soften it. It says that looking straight at the wound is the first step toward healing.
kiem_3.y_nguoc: Reversed: healing begins, forgiveness, or a wound held onto for too long. Ask yourself: have I told anyone about this pain yet?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Hurt, a break-up, a third person. Allow yourself to feel the pain, and do not add self-blame on top.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Harsh criticism or a lost job. Keep the part that is true, drop the part that is not.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money lost through someone else: painful but clear. Do not try to win it back by gambling.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Emotional heartache can show up in your chest and your sleep. Talk to someone you trust; if it stays heavy for a long time, see a doctor.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The hurt in the relationship is starting to ease, or is being held too long. Say out loud what once hurt you, to the other person or to a close friend.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: After criticism or a loss, you are getting back on your feet. Take the true part as a lesson, drop the part that makes you feel small, and carry on.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: An old loss still makes you hesitate. Write down the real numbers, close the old account in your mind, and keep an emergency fund before planning anything new.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: The sadness is settling and your sleep is slowly coming back. Let yourself walk and eat regular meals; if the low mood drags on, talk to a professional.

kiem_3.viec: Write the pain out in three clear sentences; tell one person you trust within 72 hours.
kiem_3.cau_tu_soi: Which of the three swords did your own hand put there?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: your heart is hurting right now, and any decision is likely to be a reaction to the wound. Let the worst of it pass, talk to someone you trust, then choose.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you have looked the old wound in the eye. The reversed card shows healing under way; you can move forward when you are not carrying the pain into the new decision.

kiem_4.hinh_anh: A knight lies on a stone tomb with hands joined in prayer, three swords hang on the wall and one lies beneath him; a stained-glass window glows above.
kiem_4.y_xuoi: Real rest, not giving up. This card says: step away from the noise, lie down, and let your head cool before you pick up the sword again.
kiem_4.y_nguoc: Reversed: the rest is done and you are coming back, or you refuse to rest until you are worn out. Ask yourself: do I need rest, or am I hiding?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Step back for a while to calm down. Do not have the big talk when you are tired.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Take leave, pause the project. Recover first, decide afterwards.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Hold steady and make no moves. Let the money sit quietly for a while.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: You need sleep, lying down, stretching. If the tiredness lasts for weeks, see a doctor instead of pushing through.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You are calm enough to revisit the old matter, or you are gritting your teeth and refusing to step back. Set a time to talk when neither of you is tired.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Rest is over and it is time to return, or you have been working non-stop until you are drained. Plan your return starting with small tasks, and keep one day off each week.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: The money has sat still long enough; you can look at the plan again. Start with small amounts, and do not pour everything in at once.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Your body is asking for rest you have not given it. Catch up on sleep with a regular schedule, cut back on evening work; if the tiredness lasts for weeks, see a doctor.

kiem_4.viec: Two days without discussing or reading anything about this matter; sleep a full 7 hours each night.
kiem_4.cau_tu_soi: When was the last time you rested without feeling guilty?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: this card says rest first, decide later. Give yourself a few quiet days, then look again; a decision made while exhausted tends to go wrong.
tra_loi.n: Yes, on a condition: that you have truly rested. The reversed card is the time to come back; check whether you have really recovered or are just carrying on so you do not have to stop.

kiem_5.hinh_anh: A smirking figure gathers up swords left behind while two others walk away with their backs turned; the sky is torn with cloud.
kiem_5.y_xuoi: Someone wins, but everyone loses: a fight that leaves both sides looking worse. This card says to walk away from a battle that is not worth it, even if you are the one holding the sword.
kiem_5.y_nguoc: Reversed: letting the quarrel go, making peace, owning your part. Ask yourself: what do I actually gain by winning this?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A bitter argument where you win the point and lose the warmth. Apologise first if that is what it deserves.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Office politics, a win that was not fair. Step out of a game that is played dirty.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Gain at someone else's expense, a scramble over money. Do not take money that makes you smaller.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Stress from arguing. Find a way to release it, notice tension in your neck and jaw, and get enough sleep.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The argument is starting to cool and there is room to make up. Own your share of the fault first and say one apology without the word 'but'.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You can step out of the win-or-lose contest at work. Say plainly what you need and drop the battles that are not worth it.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: The dispute over money can be closed if you give a little. Put the agreement in writing, and stop insisting on getting every last bit.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Stress from the clash is easing. Let it out with gentle exercise, get enough sleep, and avoid rereading the messages that made you angry.

kiem_5.viec: Step out of one argument (go quiet, or apologise) within 72 hours; write down what you kept by doing so.
kiem_5.cau_tu_soi: Which fight are you fighting only so that you do not lose?

tra_loi.x: Better to change the approach first: winning this could cost you a person or your good name. Ask what you gain if you win; if it is only about winning, stop.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you can let go of winning and losing. The reversed card opens the way to making peace; move forward once you have spoken plainly with the people involved and hold no grudge.

kiem_6.hinh_anh: A ferryman poles a boat carrying a woman and a child, six swords standing in the bow, toward calmer water on the far side.
kiem_6.y_xuoi: You are leaving a hard place for a calmer one: slowly, with someone to carry you, and with a few swords still on board. This card is about transition. It is not joyful yet, but it is the right direction.
kiem_6.y_nguoc: Reversed: you cannot get moving, or you are carrying the whole old load into the new place. Ask yourself: which sword am I still carrying with me?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Leaving a difficult chapter. You need someone to carry you for a while (friends), and it is not the moment for a new love yet.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Changing jobs or places after a tense period. Go slowly, with a plan.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Moving money to a safer place, and accepting the fees that come with it.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Slow recovery. Walk, get a change of air, and keep an eye on your mood when you move house.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You want to leave the old story but you are still carrying it. Write down what you have not let go of and tell a close friend before you start something new.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The job change is not finished, or the new place still runs on old habits. List what you do not want to repeat and check whether the new place is really different.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: The transfer has not gone through smoothly and the fees are higher than planned. Check each item and keep an emergency fund before you move anything else.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: A new place but the same old routine, so the tiredness follows you. Keep a fixed bedtime through the move and give yourself a few days to settle in.

kiem_6.viec: Schedule one thing this week that takes you 'to the other shore' (change your seat, change your schedule, tidy a corner); leave one old thing behind.
kiem_6.cau_tu_soi: Who is carrying you across, and have you thanked them yet?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card speaks of leaving a hard stretch for a calmer one. Go slowly, with a plan, and ask someone you trust to travel part of the way with you.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, but set the old load down first. Check whether the thing that makes you want to leave travels with you to the new place; if it is, change the way you do things first.

kiem_7.hinh_anh: A figure tiptoes away from an army camp hugging five swords, leaving two behind; the tents stand in the background.
kiem_7.y_xuoi: Something is being done on the sly, by you or by someone around you. This card is about cleverness and dodging a face-to-face: it can get the job done, but you cannot carry it all, and you leave a trace.
kiem_7.y_nguoc: Reversed: being found out, owning up, no more sneaking around. Ask yourself: who am I avoiding so that I do not have to speak plainly?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Hiding things, small lies, peeking at a phone. Secret doings wear a relationship thin.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Manoeuvring at the company, borrowing other people's ideas. Be careful of being found out; do it straight instead.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Hidden money, clever loopholes. Check contracts and middlemen carefully.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Dodging self-care: skipping check-ups, hiding a habit. Book the routine check-up instead of avoiding it.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: What is hidden tends to come out, or you want to tell the truth. Say plainly what you have been avoiding before the other person finds out on their own.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Shortcuts at work are no longer working. Give credit clearly and talk straight with the people involved instead of working behind their backs.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Money that is not transparent tends to come to light. Reconcile the books, declare everything, and step out of any deal you would have to hide from others.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Habits you hide from your body are showing. Stop dodging self-care and book the routine check-up you have been putting off.

kiem_7.viec: Tell the person involved, plainly, about one thing you handled in a roundabout way; or return something that is not yours.
kiem_7.cau_tu_soi: Which sword are you sneaking away with, and which one are you leaving behind?

tra_loi.x: Better to change the approach first: this card points to sneaking and shortcuts. If the plan only works by hiding it from someone, think again; do it when you can say it openly.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you put everything on the table first. The reversed card is the moment to drop the tricks; you can move forward once the people involved know the full picture.

tu_khoa: believing there is no way out
kiem_8.hinh_anh: A blindfolded woman stands loosely bound among eight swords planted around her, with a castle in the distance.
kiem_8.y_xuoi: You feel trapped, yet the ropes are loose, the swords do not touch you, and your feet are free. This card is about a trap made of thinking: real inside your head, not real on the ground.
kiem_8.y_nguoc: Reversed: you see the way, untie yourself, step out. Ask yourself: what is it I 'cannot' do that I have not even tried?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Feeling stuck in the relationship, usually out of fear of change. Try one small step.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Hemmed in by tasks, a boss, a schedule. Look closely at the ropes; many of them you tied yourself.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Believing you can never get out of debt. Make an honest list of what you owe and ask for advice.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Anxiety, a choked feeling. Breathe, go for a walk; if the worry drags on, see a doctor rather than carrying it alone.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: You are starting to see you are not as stuck as you thought. Try one small step: name one real need and see what changes.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The ropes at work are loosening and you can see a way out. Send one proposal, ask about one opportunity, and do not wait for someone to untie you.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: The debt sheet is less frightening than it looked in your head. List every item, call to ask about adjusting the repayment schedule, and do not borrow more to cover it.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: The choked feeling eases once you move. Walk every day and practise slow breathing; if the worry still drags on, talk to a professional.

kiem_8.viec: Do ONE thing you believe is 'impossible' in this matter, at the smallest possible size (one phone call, one question).
kiem_8.cau_tu_soi: Which of the eight ropes did you tie yourself?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: you feel tied up, and many of the ropes are made of fear. Try one small step first to see whether the path is really as narrow as you think.
tra_loi.n: Leans yes: the reversed card is the moment to untie yourself and step out. The only condition is that you take a real first step rather than stopping at thinking about it.

kiem_9.hinh_anh: A figure sits up in bed at night with face in hands, nine swords hanging flat on the wall; the quilt is embroidered with roses and zodiac signs.
kiem_9.y_xuoi: A long night of worry: regret, fear, self-blame, with nine swords on the wall rather than in you. This card is about a worry larger than the facts. It reminds you that morning comes, and that the quilt beneath you has flowers on it.
kiem_9.y_nguoc: Reversed: the worry eases, you manage to say it out loud, daylight comes. Ask yourself: does this worry have evidence, or does it only have the night?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Worry about the relationship, jealousy, regret. Talk to your partner or a close friend, and do not decide anything in the middle of the night.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Fear of losing the job, fear of mistakes. Write the tasks on paper tomorrow morning and split them up.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money worries that keep you awake. Write down the real numbers and ask someone who knows; many worries have no number attached.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Sleeplessness and worry. Keep a fixed bedtime, cut screen time; if the worry lasts more than two weeks, see a doctor rather than guessing on your own.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The worry about the relationship gets lighter once it is spoken. Ask directly about what you fear, in daylight, instead of guessing alone late at night.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The fear about work is bigger than the reality. Write the tasks down in the morning and mark which have evidence and which are only worry.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Money worry settles when you look at real numbers. Write out one month of income and spending, ask someone who knows, and break the big item into small steps.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Sleep returns as your head gets lighter. Keep a fixed bedtime and cut evening screens; if the worry drags on, talk to a professional.

kiem_9.viec: Tonight, write your worries on paper and fold it away; tomorrow morning, read it and cross out every line that has no evidence.
kiem_9.cau_tu_soi: Of the nine worries, how many are real in daylight?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: when the worry is this heavy, fear makes every option look worse. Wait for morning, list the real evidence, and ask one clear-headed person.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, once the worry has settled. The reversed card shows you are coming into the light; move forward if the decision rests on facts, not on the night's anxiety.

kiem_10.hinh_anh: A figure lies face down with ten swords in the back under a black sky, but the horizon is already turning gold.
kiem_10.y_xuoi: Rock bottom: something ends painfully, perhaps at the hands of someone close. This card is heavy, but it is also the last of the Swords: there are no more swords left to add, and the horizon is already lightening.
kiem_10.y_nguoc: Reversed: you survived, you are getting up, the worst is behind you. Ask yourself: if this is the bottom, what is the first step up?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A painful ending, a betrayal. Allow yourself to grieve, look at the lightening horizon, and do not rush back in.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A big failure or being cheated. Learn the lesson, rest, then start again differently.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: A heavy loss. Go over every item, ask a financial professional, and do not try to win it back by gambling.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Exhaustion. You need a long rest; if your body shows strong symptoms, see a doctor right away.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The most painful part is behind you and you are getting up. Do not rush back; look after yourself first, then think about anything new.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: After the fall, you can rebuild in a different way. Write down three lessons and start with one small task you can do with a steady hand.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: You have touched the bottom financially and now it is time to rebuild. Plan to repay one item at a time, keep a small emergency fund, and do not gamble to recover.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Your strength is returning after a period of exhaustion. Rest on a schedule, eat and sleep regularly; if you are still very tired, go for a routine check-up.

kiem_10.viec: Take one full day off; the next day write three small tasks for the coming week; ask one person to check whether you did them.
kiem_10.cau_tu_soi: What has ended for good, and is there anywhere you already feel lighter?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: this card speaks of an ending, not a beginning. Let the old matter close fully and rest to regain your strength before planning the next step.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you start again in small steps. The reversed card says the worst is behind you; you can move forward as long as you do not repeat exactly the old way.

kiem_tieu_dong.hinh_anh: A young person stands on a windy hill holding a sword high, clouds racing and birds far off.
kiem_tieu_dong.y_xuoi: A quick, curious, watchful mind: a piece of news, a sharp young person, or you yourself keeping watch. This card is about a mind still learning: many questions, little patience.
kiem_tieu_dong.y_nguoc: Reversed: prying, gossip, false rumours, speaking before thinking. Ask yourself: am I asking in order to understand, or to catch someone out?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Probing messages, a touch of jealousy, sharp words. Ask directly instead of fishing.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A quick-witted newcomer, news around the company. Check the source before you pass it on.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money news that is not yet confirmed. Check the source.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Lots of thinking, little sleep. Breathe deeply and notice your breathing when you are tense.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Snooping, reading messages or hearing things second-hand wears the relationship thin. Ask one direct question, then trust the answer you hear.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Rumours at work, words spoken before they are thought through. Check the source before forwarding anything and keep private stories private.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Money tips heard from others have no source yet. Do not put money down on hearsay; check for yourself and ask an official source.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Too much thinking, too little sleep, a mind that is always switched on. Turn off notifications in the evening and practise slow breathing for a few minutes before bed.

kiem_tieu_dong.viec: Before forwarding any news in the next three days, check where it came from; turn one sharp remark into a clear one.
kiem_tieu_dong.cau_tu_soi: Who are you keeping watch on, and why?

tra_loi.x: Possibly, but ask more questions first: this card is the curious, quick one whose information is still thin. Check the source and ask the people involved before you decide.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: the information is mixed with rumours and hearsay. Find an official source; if all you have is what you heard from others, wait a little longer.

kiem_tieu_dong.nhan_vat: A sharp, curious, watchful young person; when off balance, this turns into prying.

kiem_hiep_si.hinh_anh: A knight gallops into the wind with sword raised, trees bending and clouds torn apart.
kiem_hiep_si.y_xuoi: Charging in with reason and speed: debating, decisive, saying it straight without hesitation. This card is about the drive of the mind, strong when the argument is sound, harmful when it forgets the person on the other side.
kiem_hiep_si.y_nguoc: Reversed: snapping for no reason, pressing on regardless, words that wound. Ask yourself: am I defending the truth or defending my ego?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Someone who speaks so straight it turns harsh; quick arguments. Slow down before saying something you cannot take back.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Pushing a project forward by argument and winning the debate. Remember the person who lost is still on your team.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Quick money decisions. Check once more before you sign.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Tense and fast. Keep an eye on your blood pressure and your sleep, and drive slowly.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Fast, sharp words can blow a small thing up into a big one. Pause ten seconds before replying; say what is needed and drop what is only there to win.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Charging into work regardless and pushing others aside. Slow down and ask the team one question before you make the final call.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Quick money decisions without enough thought lead to bad deals. Sleep on it before signing, and check the numbers and the terms again.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Life is running too fast and your head is strung tight. Cut back on coffee, get enough sleep, and drive slowly.

kiem_hiep_si.viec: About your most recent argument: write three of your reasons, then write three of the other person's.
kiem_hiep_si.cau_tu_soi: Who are you galloping toward with your sword drawn?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card is a time for quick, decisive action. Go ahead, but check once more before signing, and do not trample the people working with you.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: the reversed card is charging ahead regardless. Slow down, ask one other person's opinion, and see whether you are following reason or your temper.

kiem_hiep_si.nhan_vat: A decisive, fast, sharp person; when off balance, this turns harsh and reckless.

kiem_hoang_hau.hinh_anh: The queen sits on a throne carved with angels, one hand holding a sword upright, the other extended, looking to the side; clouds gather at her feet.
kiem_hoang_hau.y_xuoi: Someone experienced, clear-spoken, with firm boundaries, often a person who has been through loss and no longer needs comforting. This card is about clear-eyed independence.
kiem_hoang_hau.y_nguoc: Reversed: bitter, cold, shutting the door on everyone. Ask yourself: are my boundaries protecting me or locking me in?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: An independent, clear person. The relationship needs you to soften in the places where being right does not matter.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Straight-talking management, advisory or legal work. Good for decisions made without sentiment.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Clear money decisions, cutting what is excess; financial advice.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: A disciplined routine. Notice dryness, cold and your sleep, and say your feelings out loud instead of holding them in.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The wall you have built is keeping everyone at a distance. Choose one person you trust and tell them one true thing, with no reasoning attached.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Straightness has tipped into bitterness, and feedback has become criticism. Praise one thing first, then offer one suggestion; talk about the work, not the person.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Cutting spending too hard is suffocating you and your family. Keep a little money for small pleasures and check whether the cuts are reasonable.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Holding feelings inside makes the body tense. Write in a journal for ten minutes each evening, go to bed on time, and see your friends.

kiem_hoang_hau.viec: State one boundary clearly to one person within 72 hours: short, with no long explanation.
kiem_hoang_hau.cau_tu_soi: With whom are you being 'clear' when you are really being cold?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card suits a decision made with a clear head and firm boundaries. Go ahead once you have weighed the information fully and are not letting a passing feeling lead the way.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: while you are shutting everyone out, the reversed card is cold and bitter. Listen to one more friend you trust and check whether this choice would isolate you.

kiem_hoang_hau.nhan_vat: An experienced, independent, clear-spoken person; when off balance, this turns bitter.

kiem_vua.hinh_anh: The king sits upright on his throne with sword raised, looking straight ahead; clouds and birds behind him.
kiem_vua.y_xuoi: Someone who judges by reason: a lawyer, a judge, a strict head of something. This card is about a mature mind that decides on principle, not on sentiment.
kiem_vua.y_nguoc: Reversed: abusing power, cold, using logic to force others. Ask yourself: am I right by the rules, or right by the people?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A serious, rational person. The relationship needs warmth alongside reason.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Suited to legal work, management, settling disputes. For anything involving a lawsuit, ask a real lawyer.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money decisions made on principle, clear contracts, no going soft on an item that is wrong.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Good discipline. Notice stiffness in your neck and back when sitting, and loosen up.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Logic is being used to make the other person give in. Ask how they feel before proving who is right.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Authority used rigidly: little listening, lots of ordering. Invite someone junior to offer one idea and genuinely weigh it.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Money rules are being used to keep power over others. Be transparent with the numbers and ask a lawyer or professional about any large contract.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Rigid and tense, the mind pushing on without rest. Stretch your neck and shoulders every hour, sleep enough, and do less work in the evening.

kiem_vua.viec: Write one clear principle for this matter (one line) and apply it fairly to yourself first.
kiem_vua.cau_tu_soi: Whom are you judging by the rules without asking them?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card stands on the side of a decision with principles and figures behind it. Go ahead once you have read the paperwork carefully and can explain it fairly to everyone.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: the reversed card is reason or power used to force a result. Check whether this decision is fair to the people it affects, and ask a professional.

kiem_vua.nhan_vat: A person who judges by reason and carries authority; when off balance, this turns cold and domineering.

tien_1.hinh_anh: A hand reaches out of a cloud holding a gold coin; below lies a flower garden with an arched gate opening onto the mountains.
tien_1.y_xuoi: A chance you can touch: a job, money, a home, your health. The seed is in your hand and the soil is ready. This card says: plant it, and tend it steadily.
tien_1.y_nguoc: Reversed: the chance slips by, or you want the harvest without having planted anything. Ask yourself: which seed am I still keeping in my pocket?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Solid ground for a relationship that can last; a real gesture counts for more than words.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A job offer or a new contract; take it and begin with small steps.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: New money, or something with a real base to build on; add to it steadily and don't rush to cash in.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Your body is like soil: regular meals and sleep are the planting. Start one small health habit.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: A chance to get closer that you haven't acted on. Do one small, real thing this week instead of making a big promise.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: A job chance slips because of hesitation or asking for too much. Reply to the offer that is still waiting and start with the smallest piece of the work.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: New money tends to get spent before it has a chance to grow. Set a fixed part aside into a cushion before you spend anything.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: The good habit you meant to start keeps getting pushed back. Pick the smallest one and do it today, for ten minutes.

tien_1.viec: Start ONE tangible thing for this matter (open the account, write the application, clear a desk) within 24 hours.
tien_1.cau_tu_soi: Which seed is already in your hand, still unplanted?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card is a beginning with a real base, something you can touch. Take it, start small, and make sure you have time to tend it.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you don't let it slip any further. Reversed, the chance tends to drift or wait too long; take the first step soon and don't demand results right away.

tien_2.hinh_anh: A young person juggles two coins inside a looping ribbon while ships ride the waves behind.
tien_2.y_xuoi: You are holding two things at once (work and home, two sources of income) and still dancing. This card is about flexibility: you can juggle, but don't add a third ball.
tien_2.y_nguoc: Reversed: a ball drops, you are overloaded, the balance is gone. Ask yourself: of the two things, which one truly needs me?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Balancing love and work; divide your time clearly.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Two jobs side by side, freelance life; plan your schedule and don't take on more.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Two incomes, money moving back and forth; keep the flow going and write it all down.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: A rhythm of highs and lows; keep fixed mealtimes and bedtime as your anchor.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Too many worries push the person you love to the bottom of the list. Keep one evening this week for just the two of you, phones off.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: You took on too much and balls are starting to fall. Drop or postpone one task and tell the people involved early rather than being late.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Moving money from one place to patch another until nothing balances. Write your cash flow on paper, don't borrow more to fill gaps, and deal with the nearest due date first.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Your rhythm is chaotic because you are carrying too much. Keep mealtimes and bedtime fixed and drop one commitment this week.

tien_2.viec: Put both things you are balancing on this week's calendar; say no to one new request.
tien_2.cau_tu_soi: Which ball have you been juggling for so long without setting it down?

tra_loi.x: Possibly, you can do both if you can make the schedule work. This card is about balancing two things; go ahead once you know how many hours each takes and you stop adding more.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: reversed, this is overload, balls dropping. Let go of one thing you are carrying first, then see whether you have energy for something new.

tien_3.hinh_anh: A stonemason stands on a bench inside a church while a monk and an architect holding the plans discuss the work.
tien_3.y_xuoi: Work done together, each person with their own trade, following a shared drawing. This card is about skill that gets recognised and the strength of a small team where everyone plays their part.
tien_3.y_nguoc: Reversed: poor coordination, careless work, nobody listens to the craftsman. Ask yourself: have I actually looked at the shared plan?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Build the relationship like building a house: talk it through together, each taking a part.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A team project, learning a trade, having your skill recognised; follow the plan.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money that comes from your craft; put resources into skills and build gradually.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Care for your body with a plan and someone to guide you (a trainer, a doctor).

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Two people each doing things their own way, neither listening. Sit down and plan one shared task, clear about who does which part.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The team lacks coordination and rushes sloppy work. Hold a short meeting to settle the shared plan and write down each person's deadline.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Money put into a joint venture without a clear agreement. Put each person's contribution in writing before adding any more.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Training without a plan, done on impulse. Ask someone qualified for guidance and get a routine check-up so you have real numbers.

tien_3.viec: Meet or message the two people you work with: who does what, by when. Write it down.
tien_3.cau_tu_soi: What are you building, with whom, and from which plan?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card suits work done with others, with skill and a plan. Go ahead when each person knows their part and someone is actually listened to.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if the way you coordinate can be fixed. Reversed, this is a missing shared plan; settle the plan and divide the work clearly before you start.

tien_4.hinh_anh: A figure sits clutching a coin to the chest, one coin balanced on the head and two under the feet, with a city behind.
tien_4.y_xuoi: Holding tight to what you have: safety, savings, control. This card speaks of stability already won, and asks: if you hold on this tightly, which hand is free to receive?
tien_4.y_nguoc: Reversed: so tight-fisted that people drift away, or you are finally starting to loosen your grip. Ask yourself: am I holding on because I need to, or because I'm afraid?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Holding on to someone, controlling; give the other person room to breathe.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Keeping your seat, reluctant to change; stable but stiff. Open up a little.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Good at saving, but nothing grows; set a part aside for something new.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Tension from gripping too hard; stretch, breathe, allow yourself to rest.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Holding someone too tightly, or starting to ease your grip. Ask the other person how much space they need, and truly give it.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Clinging to your position, or starting to try something new. Take on one small task outside your comfort zone.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Holding money so tightly it strains the family, or letting spending run loose. Set a clear monthly spending limit and keep a cushion.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: A body that has been braced for a long time wants to let go. Stretch each morning, rest on time, and allow yourself to slow down a little.

tien_4.viec: Give away or share ONE thing you are holding tightly (time, a small sum, a task) this week.
tien_4.cau_tu_soi: What do you hold on to most tightly, and does it really need holding?

tra_loi.x: Possibly, if you dare to loosen your grip. This card is about holding on to what you have; the new thing only works when you share some time or money with it.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, when you let go in the right place. Reversed, you are starting to release, or gripping until people leave; check whether you are letting go after real thought or just from exhaustion.

tien_5.hinh_anh: Two ragged figures walk through the snow past a brightly lit church window.
tien_5.y_xuoi: Lack of money, strength, or a feeling of being shut out, while the light is right beside you. This card says: asking for help is not shameful, and the door is open.
tien_5.y_nguoc: Reversed: help arrives, the hard stretch passes, you step inside. Ask yourself: have I knocked yet?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Feeling abandoned, lonely inside a couple; say what you need.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Out of work or short of work; ask people you know and accept temporary work.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Short of money, in debt; list it honestly, ask for support, arrange repayment. Don't hide it.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Low energy, self-care neglected; see a doctor while you have insurance; eat enough before worrying about the far future.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: The stretch of feeling alone is slowly passing. Say clearly what you need, and accept when someone offers a hand.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: People are willing to help if you speak up. Ask for a referral and take temporary work while you look.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: The tight stretch eases once you ask for support. List all your debts honestly, call the lender about a repayment schedule, and don't borrow more to cover it up.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Your strength returns as you start caring for yourself again. Eat regular meals, sleep enough, and go to the check-up you postponed.

tien_5.viec: Call or message one person you trust and ask for help with one specific thing (money, work, advice).
tien_5.cau_tu_soi: Which lit door are you walking past without knocking?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: this card is a stretch of lack, when strength is thin. Take care of the basics first, food, shelter, someone to lean on, then think about something new.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you are willing to knock. Reversed, this is help received, the hard part passing; go ahead once you have asked the right person and have at least a minimum to stand on.

tien_6.hinh_anh: A merchant holds a pair of scales and hands out coins to two kneeling figures.
tien_6.y_xuoi: Giving and receiving are flowing: those who have share, those who lack receive, and the scales stay level. This card is about fair generosity and asks which side of the scales you stand on right now.
tien_6.y_nguoc: Reversed: giving in order to control, receiving and feeling indebted, the scales tilt. Ask yourself: what conditions do I attach when I give?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Giving and receiving in the relationship; the one who gives more needs to be seen.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A bonus, a raise, support from a fair boss; credit shared clearly.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money coming in through support, a debt repaid, or giving to charity; give in the right measure.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Accept help with your health (a doctor, a workout partner); give yourself your fair share.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Giving with strings attached, or receiving and feeling you owe. Say plainly that you give because you want to, nothing owed, or decline gently.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Support, rewards and penalties handed out unevenly; someone feels shortchanged. Ask for clear criteria and a transparent split of credit.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Lending and borrowing is straining a relationship. Put it in writing, lend only what you could afford to lose, and keep a cushion.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Giving so much to others that your own tank runs dry. Keep some rest time for yourself and accept help without feeling indebted.

tien_6.viec: Give a small amount (money, an hour, an item) to someone who needs it; accept one offer of help you have been refusing.
tien_6.cau_tu_soi: Are you on the giving side or the receiving side, and are you at ease there?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card is giving and receiving in fair measure, with someone willing to support you. Go ahead when the terms on both sides are clear and no one is left carrying a heavy debt of gratitude.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, but look at the scales first. Reversed, this is giving to keep power, or receiving and owing; act once the conditions have been spoken out loud.

tien_7.hinh_anh: A farmer leans on a hoe and gazes at a bush heavy with coins that are not yet ripe.
tien_7.y_xuoi: You have planted and now you wait, wondering if it was worth it. This card is about a mid-way review: see how far the plant has grown, then decide whether to keep tending or move the planting elsewhere.
tien_7.y_nguoc: Reversed: impatience, quitting before it ripens, or effort put in the wrong place. Ask yourself: what am I waiting for, and until when?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A relationship ripening slowly; assess whether to keep nurturing it, without forcing.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A long project awaiting results; review your numbers; patience has a limit.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: A long-term commitment that hasn't paid off yet; review it, don't pull out early, and don't pour more in blindly.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Health habits take time; assess after three months; get a check-up so you have numbers.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Impatient for the relationship to move faster, or giving up before you understand each other. Look back at what you have nurtured and choose clearly whether to continue or stop.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Quitting before the work ripens, or pouring energy into the wrong spot. Review three months of numbers, keep what is growing, cut what is going nowhere.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Pulling money out too early out of impatience, or adding more to something unclear. Check the numbers again, don't borrow to double down, and keep a cushion.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Dropping a good habit because you don't see results yet. Keep it one more month, note the small changes, and get a routine check-up for real numbers.

tien_7.viec: Write three measures for the thing you are waiting on; set a review date (30 days); decide then, not today.
tien_7.cau_tu_soi: Which plant are you waiting on, and how long has it been?

tra_loi.x: Not yet: this card is the moment of standing in the garden before the season has come. Patience has a limit; set a date to review the numbers, then decide whether to continue or change.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, once you change the approach. Reversed, this is impatience or effort in the wrong place; look at where you are spending your energy and keep going where results are showing.

tien_8.hinh_anh: A craftsman sits carving a coin, the finished ones hung on a post beside him, a city far in the distance.
tien_8.y_xuoi: Steady, careful work, one coin at a time. This card is about honing a skill: nothing flashy, yet this is what makes everything that lasts.
tien_8.y_nguoc: Reversed: working just to get it over with, or perfecting endlessly and never finishing; tired of repeating. Ask yourself: am I practising, or just repeating?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Tend the relationship with small, regular acts; no grand gestures needed.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Learning a trade, training, detailed work; progress every day.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Steady money from your skill; save a fixed amount each month.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Exercise regularly, eat regularly; a small daily habit beats a big burst.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Caring for each other half-heartedly, or demanding perfection until you are both worn out. Do one small thing for the other person each day; it doesn't have to be pretty.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Repeating until you are bored, or polishing forever without finishing. Set a deadline and learn one new skill to change the rhythm.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Income from your craft has stalled because you are just going through the motions. Review your rates, make time to learn more of your trade, and keep saving steadily.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Exercise has gone stale and is easy to drop. Change the routine, keep a regular bedtime; a small habit still beats a big push you abandon.

tien_8.viec: Pick one skill tied to this matter; practise it 20 minutes a day for seven days; tick each day off.
tien_8.cau_tu_soi: Which coin are you carving right now, and how many have you finished?
