tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card sides with diligent work, learning a trade, progress day by day. Go ahead when you are ready to put in steady effort without expecting instant results.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you change your working rhythm. Reversed, this is going through the motions or perfecting without finishing; set a clear deadline and check whether you are practising or just repeating.

tien_9.hinh_anh: An elegant woman stands in a vineyard with a falcon on her hand, nine coins around her.
tien_9.y_xuoi: Self-sufficiency: results you made yourself, a garden of your own, needing no one. This card is about independence that has ripened, and a reminder that a beautiful garden still needs guests.
tien_9.y_nguoc: Reversed: financial dependence, showing off, or loneliness in the middle of plenty. Ask yourself: am I self-sufficient, or just alone?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Loving without needing; suits an independent partner; invite someone into your garden.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Personal achievement, working on your own terms; enjoy it and share what you have learned.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Enough money, assets of your own; enjoy within limits and keep what you have on safe ground.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Healthy and well looked after; keep your routine; watch for being overly fussy about food.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Plenty, yet feeling alone, or leaning on the other person. Truly invite someone into your life, including the parts that aren't pretty.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Personal success with no one to share it, or depending on a single source. Reconnect with colleagues and open one more channel of work.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Depending on someone else's money, or spending to impress. Build a fund of your own and review what you spend on image.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Polishing the outside while forgetting your rhythm. Keep a regular bedtime, go out and meet people, and keep your check-up appointments.

tien_9.viec: Invite one person to the place or project you are proud of (your home, your work, a skill) and show them.
tien_9.cau_tu_soi: Are you enjoying your garden, or just standing guard over it?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card is self-sufficiency, results made by your own hands. Go ahead when you can do it on your own strength and still keep the life you have built.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you don't lean entirely on anyone. Reversed, this is dependence or plenty with loneliness; check whether this keeps you in charge of yourself before you say yes.

tien_10.hinh_anh: An old man sits with his dogs while a couple and a child stand under an archway, ten coins arranged across the scene.
tien_10.y_xuoi: Wealth in the widest sense: a home, a trade, habits, people; three generations under one gate. This card is about what lasts, and reminds you that riches are not only money.
tien_10.y_nguoc: Reversed: quarrels over property within the family, tradition as a burden, rich but empty. Ask yourself: what have I received from my family, and what am I leaving behind?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Family stability, a marriage with a solid base, many generations; look again at what the family expects.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A family business, a trade passed down, long-term stability; suits long commitments.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Large assets, inheritance, property; paperwork between siblings needs to be clear.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Pay attention to health patterns that run in the family (eating habits, the elders' conditions); get check-ups for the whole family.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Family pressure and the clan's expectations weigh on the two of you. Tell your relatives clearly what the two of you decide for yourselves.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: The family business or inherited trade has become a burden. Separate your responsibilities clearly and say what you want to do differently.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Shared family property easily breeds disputes. Put it in writing, consult a professional before dividing anything, and don't rely on verbal promises.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: The whole household's habits are wearing you down too. Change one shared eating or sleeping habit and take the family for a check-up.

tien_10.viec: Call or visit an elder in your family; ask about one thing in the family trade or household ways that you don't yet know.
tien_10.cau_tu_soi: What wealth in your family isn't money?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card is a long-term base with the family behind you. Go ahead when this benefits the whole household over time and the paperwork is clear.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, but clear up the family matter first. Reversed, this is disputes over property or the weight of expectations; go ahead once you have talked it through with your relatives.

tien_tieu_dong.hinh_anh: A young person holds a coin up before their eyes and studies it intently, standing in a green field.
tien_tieu_dong.y_xuoi: A small, real opportunity and the diligence of an apprentice. This card is earth still learning: slow, careful, trusting what can be touched.
tien_tieu_dong.y_nguoc: Reversed: laziness, quitting your studies halfway, dreaming of money without working for it. Ask yourself: am I learning, or just dreaming about the result?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Practical affection, a slow start; small, genuine gestures.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A scholarship, an internship, a new trade; take on small tasks and do them well.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Small sums, starting to save, learning about money.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Starting good habits: walking, going to bed on time; learning about your own body.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Dreaming of a relationship without doing anything about it. Send one genuine message and set a specific time to meet.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Studies left unfinished, avoiding small tasks. Go back to the course you dropped and finish one lesson before planning further.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Dreaming of fast money while skipping the slow build. Start a small fixed savings habit and stay away from get-rich-quick offers.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: You know the good habits but can't be bothered. Walk fifteen minutes after dinner and set a bedtime alarm.

tien_tieu_dong.viec: Sign up for or begin one small course or lesson connected to this matter this week.
tien_tieu_dong.cau_tu_soi: Which coin are you holding without having looked at it closely?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card is a practical start, learning from small tasks. Go ahead when you are willing to learn gradually and do each part carefully, without expecting big results at once.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: reversed, this is dreaming of results without doing the learning. Finish one concrete preparation step first, then decide.

tien_tieu_dong.nhan_vat: A hard-working, practical young person who loves to learn; when off balance, slow and plodding.

tien_hiep_si.hinh_anh: A knight sits on a black horse standing still in a ploughed field, holding a coin.
tien_hiep_si.y_xuoi: Slow, steady, and the job gets done: no flying, but you arrive. This card is about responsible persistence, suited to anything that takes time.
tien_hiep_si.y_nguoc: Reversed: stuck in a rut, dull, set in your ways, refusing to change. Ask yourself: am I persevering, or am I stuck?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A faithful, slow partner; the relationship could use a little surprise.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A steady, reliable worker, good at keeping things running; add some creativity.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Money built up steadily; patient, durable choices; avoid holding on too tightly.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: A regular routine; watch for too much sitting and too little movement; stand up every hour.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: A relationship so steady it has gone stale, and no one wants to change. Invite the other person to do one new thing together this month.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Stuck because the work is familiar and new methods feel risky. Propose one small improvement or change one step in the process.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Keeping money the old way without ever reviewing it. Go through your fixed expenses and cut what you no longer need.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Long sitting, little movement, routine turned sluggish. Stand up every hour and add one walk a week.

tien_hiep_si.viec: Finish ONE task that has been unfinished for over a month; open nothing new until it is done.
tien_hiep_si.cau_tu_soi: What are you most persistent about, and what are you simply stuck in?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card is steady, sure-handed work, so go slowly. Go ahead when you have a step-by-step plan and can accept results that arrive gradually.
tra_loi.n: Not yet: reversed, this is inertia, clinging to the old way. Check whether you want this or are just afraid of change; try one small change first.

tien_hiep_si.nhan_vat: A persistent, trustworthy person who moves slowly and surely; when off balance, stuck and dull.

tien_hoang_hau.hinh_anh: A queen sits on her throne among roses with a rabbit at her feet, cradling a coin and gazing down at it.
tien_hoang_hau.y_xuoi: Someone who cares through real things: meals, a home, enough money; this may be you, or the person holding you up right now. This card is about comfort made by your own hands.
tien_hoang_hau.y_nguoc: Reversed: so busy looking after everyone that you forget yourself, or caring only about material things. Ask yourself: who is looking after me?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A practical, caring, warm partner; love shown through deeds; remember to say the words too.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: Managing operations, a family business; creating a stable environment.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Skilful with money, suited to property and farming; keep a part for yourself.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Tend your body like a garden; watch for overload from housework; schedule your rest.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Caring for the other person until you forget yourself, or caring only with things. Say what you need and let yourself be cared for in return.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Carrying every operational task, exhausted and unseen. Hand off one part and ask for help before you reach overload.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Spending everything on others, leaving nothing for yourself. Set aside a sum for yourself each month and keep a cushion.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Looking after the whole household while dropping your own rhythm. Block out one rest period each day, sleep enough, and keep your check-ups.

tien_hoang_hau.viec: Do one act of care for yourself (a proper meal, a tidy sleeping corner, a check-up booked) before caring for anyone else.
tien_hoang_hau.cau_tu_soi: Who do you care for most, and who cares for you?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card is practical care and skilful management. Go ahead when this keeps the household running and you still have energy left for yourself.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if you don't carry it all alone. Reversed, this is looking after everyone until you forget yourself; go ahead once someone is sharing the load.

tien_hoang_hau.nhan_vat: A practical, warm carer who runs the home; when off balance, overbusy and forgetful of themselves.

tien_vua.hinh_anh: A king sits on a throne carved with bulls' heads among grapevines, holding a sceptre and a coin, a castle behind him.
tien_vua.y_xuoi: Someone who has succeeded through patience: wealth, experience, and a readiness to support others. This card is about earth at its ripest: solid, generous, and knowing how to share.
tien_vua.y_nguoc: Reversed: greedy, rigid, using money to hold people. Ask yourself: is what I own feeding someone, or binding them?

linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A stable, protective partner; the relationship needs a touch of romance alongside the safety.
linh_vuc.cong_viec: A business owner, a mentor; suited to long-term decisions; listen to younger people.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Large assets and a firm footing, often in property; share a part of it.
linh_vuc.suc_khoe: Strong but prone to excess; watch your weight and keep moving; routine check-ups.

linh_vuc_nguoc.tinh_cam: Using money or provision to hold on to someone. Ask the other person what they want beyond the material, and listen.
linh_vuc_nguoc.cong_viec: Rigid, focused only on profit, deaf to younger voices. Invite a different opinion and weigh it honestly.
linh_vuc_nguoc.tien_bac: Wanting more when you already have enough, or using money to control. Ask yourself why you want more, keep a cushion, and don't borrow to expand.
linh_vuc_nguoc.suc_khoe: Living in plenty but moving little. Walk more, eat just enough, and keep your check-up appointments.

tien_vua.viec: Use your experience or money to help someone get started (one coaching session, one small sum) this week.
tien_vua.cau_tu_soi: Where are you 'the king', and does anyone get to enjoy your vineyard?

tra_loi.x: Leans yes: this card is a firm financial base and someone experienced enough to take the lead. Go ahead when the plan has clear numbers and a fallback.
tra_loi.n: Possibly, if your motives are clean. Reversed, this is greed or using money to hold people; check who you are really doing this for, and whether it binds anyone.

tien_vua.nhan_vat: An accomplished, stable person who supports others; when off balance, greedy and rigid.

da_so._nguon: Book T (Golden Dawn) — the 'A Majority of…' passage; verbatim text in fixtures/nguon/tarot_book_t.json.

gay.nghia: A spread full of Wands: plenty of fire — drive, the urge to act now, and friction or argument close behind.

coc.nghia: A spread full of Cups: feeling and enjoyment are the main part of this matter.

kiem.nghia: A spread full of Swords: the old text is blunt; read it as a stretch of worry and tension, with something that needs saying plainly or cutting away. It is not a forecast of harm.

tien.nghia: A spread full of Pentacles: the centre of gravity is work, money, possessions and practical things.

an_chinh.nghia: A spread full of Major Arcana: forces larger than the querent's own arranging are in play; see the matter as a stage of the road.

hoang_gia.nghia: A spread full of court cards: many people are involved — meetings and other people's views carry weight.

at.nghia: A spread full of Aces: strength in general and several beginnings at once; Aces are always strong cards.
